stories.title: Phoolan Devi’s sister becomes UP president of SP's women wing:Strategy to woo women, Nishad community; Ruby Srivastava removed from post
stories.summary: SP has appointed Phoolan Devi's elder sister, Rukmini Devi Nishad, as the state president of the women's assembly. This was announced on Wednesday by SP state president Shyam Lal Pal. 67-year-old Rukmini Devi was appointed after approval from SP chief Akhilesh Yadav. Rukmini has been appointed in place of Ruby Srivastava. Rukmini originally belongs to Jalaun. Why did Rukmini get the appointment? It is believed that this appointment is not just a routine change, but part of SP's PDA strategy. SP has chosen Rukmini to make inroads into the Nishad vote bank. The Nishad-Mallah community is a major backward caste in UP. They have considerable influence in the Purvanchal and Awadh regions. Akhilesh Yadav wants to connect more strongly with this community before the 2027 assembly elections. SP's focus on women Before the elections, Akhilesh Yadav was focusing on women. Recently, Akhilesh Yadav announced the Nari Samriddhi Samman Yojana for women. Now, Phoolan Devi's sister Rukmini Devi has been given command of the women's assembly. Through this, the party is sending a message among backward caste women that SP respects women. Rukmini Devi remains active in Bundelkhand Rukmini Devi is from Shekhpur Guddha Purwa village in Jalaun. She is considered politically and socially active in Bundelkhand. She was married in Budha Dana village of Auraiya. She also has a strong family background. She has 3 sons and 2 daughters. Currently, she spends time in Gwalior along with her village. There her eldest son works as an Inspector in Mathura Police Department. Her other sons are named Santosh and Chunna. Akhilesh had gifted a Scorpio Before joining SP, Rukmini Devi was in Progressive Manav Samaj Party. She had also contested Lok Sabha elections from Fatehpur seat from this party. After this, in 2019, Rukmini Devi joined the Samajwadi Party. She has not been given any position in SP so far. Rukmani Devi is the first woman state president from the Nishad community in SP. Previous state presidents were - Madhu Gupta, Sushila Saroj, Geeta Singh, Lilavati Kushwaha and Ruby Srivastava. It is reported that recently SP president Akhilesh Yadav also gifted a Scorpio vehicle to Rukmani Devi. Nishad Party came second in the 2022 elections In the 2022 Assembly elections, UP minister Sanjay Nishad's Nishad Party contested strongly on the Kalpi seat. The Nishad Party came second with a margin of about 2,300 votes, while the SP candidate won. Therefore, the influence of the Nishad community is considered important in this region. The Nishad community includes sub-castes like Kevat, Mallah, Bind, Kashyap, Nonia, Manjhi. This is primarily an OBC community associated with rivers, streams and fishing. How influential are Nishads in UP? The Nishad community has approximately 4.5% vote bank in Uttar Pradesh. On 80 assembly seats in Uttar Pradesh, the number of Nishad voters is around one lakh. The Nishad community influences 160 seats in the state. The population of Nishad community in the state is approximately 4.5 percent. However, many of its sub-castes are counted separately. If all sub-castes are combined, it is about 9 percent. Nishads are present in large numbers in districts like Gorakhpur, Varanasi, Azamgarh, Ballia, Mau, Ghazipur, Mirzapur, Bhadohi, Jaunpur, Prayagraj, Sultanpur, Fatehpur etc. in the state. In the 2022 Assembly elections, Nishad Party contested 15 seats in the NDA alliance. They won 9 seats then. Out of these, 6 won on their symbol. Others were elected on BJP's symbol.

stories.title: Raj Babbar acquitted in assault case involving election officer:Case filed in Lucknow 30 years ago; contested election against Atal Bihari
stories.summary: The UP Congress Committee's former president and former MP Raj Babbar was given major relief by Lucknow's MP/MLA court on Wednesday. All cases registered against him during the 1996 Lok Sabha elections were dismissed, and he was acquitted. Earlier, the special court had found Raj Babbar guilty on July 7, 2022, and sentenced him to 2 years' imprisonment. Upon being acquitted today, Raj Babbar says, 'I have faith in the country's democracy and constitution. I will continue to struggle for the protection of the constitution, democracy, and people's rights'. Contested election against former Prime Minister Atal Bihari Former Prime Minister Atal Bihari Vajpayee was the BJP's candidate from Lucknow Lok Sabha in 1996. Samajwadi Party fielded Raj Babbar against him for the first time. On the day of voting, Raj Babbar got into an argument with the election officer over fake voting at a polling booth. After this, the election officer filed a case against Raj Babbar at Lucknow's Wazirganj police station, accusing him of assault and obstructing government work. The trial of this case was ongoing in Lucknow's MP/MLA court. High Court's Lucknow bench had also stayed the sentence Earlier, the special court had convicted Raj Babbar on July 7, 2022, sentencing him to 2 years' imprisonment and imposing a fine of ₹8,500. After this, Raj Babbar filed a petition against the sentence in the Lucknow bench of the Allahabad High Court. The court had stayed his sentence on this. This gave him relief in contesting elections. However, the case was not completely over then. Raj Babbar says, ‘FIR was filed with political malice’ Currently, Raj Babbar is active in the Congress party. Raj Babbar expressed happiness at being acquitted in the case. He said that in the political environment of that time, such actions were taken against me with the intention of weakening the democratic system. These were very unfortunate. I am a soldier of the Congress party. I have faith in the country's democracy and constitution. Meanwhile, Congress leaders also called this decision a victory of justice, saying that this proves that in 1996, the opposition tried to implicate Raj Babbar in false cases out of fear of his popularity.

stories.title: Rinku Singh says will soon seek CM Yogi’s blessings:Cricketer to collect RSO joining letter; missed Lucknow visit due to IPL
stories.summary: 'Due to being with IPL team KKR, I couldn't attend the event. Due to cricket schedule, I had a prior commitment. For this reason, I couldn't be present at the ceremony. I will soon come to Lucknow to take blessings from Chief Minister Yogi. I will collect my RSO joining letter.' Cricketer Rinku Singh said this on Wednesday through a released video. He expressed gratitude to CM Yogi. He said that I am happy that the UP government has given a reward of ₹3 crore and made me a Regional Sports Officer (RSO). Actually, on Tuesday, CM Yogi distributed joining letters and honor amounts to 5 players from UP in an event in Lucknow. Cricketer Rinku Singh did not attend this event. Rinku Singh says, ‘Will meet CM Yogi soon’ In the video, Rinku Singh thanked Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath, saying that this honor is a matter of pride for him. He will soon come to Lucknow to meet the Chief Minister, receive his appointment letter, and take his blessings. Rinku awarded ₹3 crore prize and RSO position UP government has appointed Rinku Singh as Regional Sports Officer (RSO), along with a cash prize of ₹3 crore. This honor has been given for his outstanding performance in his cricket career and for bringing glory to the state. CM Yogi distributed joining letters to athletes in Lucknow In an event held in Lucknow on the evening of March 24, CM Yogi handed over joining letters to 5 athletes of the state. He also honored 40 athletes. Rajkumar Pal from Ghazipur was appointed as DSP in the police department. Olympic medal-winning athletes Praveen Kumar from Noida, Ajit Singh from Etawah, and Sumiran from Ghaziabad were appointed as officers in the Panchayati Raj department. Muzaffarnagar's Preethi Pal has been assigned the post of Block Development Officer (BDO). CM Yogi created a light-hearted atmosphere During the program, CM Yogi appeared in a light-hearted mood. He joked, saying, ‘Our Home Secretary has also played gully-danda. He also added that whether sixes and fours are hit anywhere, the ball and bat are from UP’. People present at the event were seen smiling at his remarks.

stories.title: HC bars Avimukteshwaranand's arrest till chargesheet in sexual abuse case:Court orders both parties to restrain from making media statements
stories.summary: Shankaracharya Avimukteshwaranand Saraswati's bail was granted by the Allahabad High Court on Wednesday. The court said that Shankaracharya would not be arrested until the charge sheet was filed. This decision was pronounced by a bench of Justice Jitendra Kumar Sinha of the High Court at 3.45 pm. The Allahabad High Court also imposed several conditions while granting bail to Avimukteshwaranand. The most important condition is that both parties (Shankaracharya and Ashutosh) will neither make statements nor give interviews. If the bail conditions are violated, the other party can file a bail cancellation application. During the pronouncement of this decision, Shankaracharya's lawyers said - Your Honor, please also state that someone starts roaming with children, someone makes statements during the journey. This should also be stopped. On this, the court said that it should not be violated. Decision was reserved on February 27 The Allahabad High Court had stayed Shankaracharya's arrest on February 27 in the sexual harassment case. Then Justice Jitendra Kumar Sinha had said that Shankaracharya would not be arrested until the decision came. Shankaracharya will cooperate with the police investigation. Shankaracharya's side was represented in court by advocate P.N. Mishra, while Additional Advocate General Manish Goyal appeared on behalf of the state government. Complainant Ashutosh Maharaj's lawyer Reena Singh also presented arguments. Shankaracharya had filed a petition for anticipatory bail on February 24 in the case of sexual harassment of young students (batuks). Actually, Ashutosh Brahmachari, a disciple of Tulsipithadhishwar Swami Rambhadracharya, had filed a petition in the District Court on February 8. Following the order of Judge (Rape and POCSO Special Court) Vinod Kumar Chaurasia, the Jhansi police registered an FIR on February 21 against Swami Avimukteshwaranand for sodomy with young students (batuks). After the court's decision, Shankaracharya told Dainik Bhaskar in Kashi - Whatever it takes to bring out the truth, including a narco test, should be done. Lies do not have a long life. All evidence will be presented. If the decision does not come in our favour, we will approach the higher court (Supreme Court). Now know the full story

stories.title: 2-day Ram Navami holiday in UP:Employees with Saturday off to enjoy a 4-day long weekend
stories.summary: The Yogi government has announced a 2-day holiday for Ram Navami in the state. Now, there will be a holiday on both March 26 and March 27. Because March 28 is a Saturday, most government and private offices will remain closed. March 29 is already a Sunday holiday. In this way, people who have a holiday on Saturday will get a 4-day break. Earlier, the Ram Navami holiday in the government calendar was fixed for March 26. However, this year the Navami Tithi falls on March 27. On this day, processions are taken out in many cities, and temples see a large number of devotees. Keeping this in mind, the Yogi government issued the new order on Wednesday afternoon. Earlier, the government had announced holidays on March 2, 3, and 4 for Holi. March 1 was a Sunday. Employees had received a 4-day holiday consecutively. Banks will open only one day in 6 days Banks will remain closed for 5 days. March 26 and 27 are holidays for Ram Navami. Due to March 28 being the fourth Saturday of the month, banks across the country will remain closed. March 29 is a Sunday. After opening on March 30, i.e., Monday, banks will again remain closed on March 31 due to Mahavir Jayanti. This means banks will be open for only one day between March 26 and March 31.

stories.title: Invest UP plans ₹25,000 crore deal:Signs MOU with PUCH–AI, questions raised over company’s low turnover
stories.summary: Invest UP has taken steps towards a Rs 25,000 crore AI deal. A Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) has been signed with Bengaluru-based startup company Puch-AI. This company is only one and a half years old. On March 23, Invest UP claimed that after this MoU, UP would become the country's leading 'AI state'. Meanwhile, after this MoU came to light, people are asking questions on social media. They are saying that how will such a small company, with a turnover of Rs 42.9 lakh, handle such a big project? What will be included in this project? Startup company is one and a half years old The Puch-AI with which Invest UP has signed an MoU is one and a half years old. The founders of this Bengaluru-based startup are Siddharth Bhatia and Arijit Jain. Both started this company with their own money in 2025. Puch-AI provides free WhatsApp-based voice AI service in 20 Indian languages for people living outside urban areas. Experts claim that many companies are already providing the kind of free service that the company is offering. As soon as the information about this deal became public, people started trolling this company. They wrote - this startup's annual revenue is not even 50 lakh rupees. How was an MoU worth 25 thousand crore rupees signed with it? However, the company clarified that it has other projects as well. The company has not hidden anything. Some people are raising questions about this for political reasons. 3 Questions Being Raised on Social Media

stories.title: Rare surgery in Kanpur:TB lump removed from child’s heart after stopping heartbeat for 4 hours, doctors call it a first case
stories.summary: Doctors at Kanpur's Institute of Cardiology (LPS Cardiology) have given a new lease of life to a 12-year-old girl by operating on her for about 4 hours. A massive tuberculous mass had formed in the right atrium of Laxmi Patel, a resident of Fatehpur, which had almost blocked the blood flow. Dr. Rakesh Verma, Director of LPS Cardiology, claims that this is the first such case in the world, which will now be sent for publication in international medical journals. Breathing was difficult, the body had swollen Laxmi, a resident of Khanddevar, Fatehpur, was admitted to the CVTS department of the institute on February 24. At that time, the girl's condition was extremely critical. She was experiencing difficulty breathing while sitting, and her entire body, along with her legs, had swollen. Investigations revealed that her heartbeat was also abnormal, and there was fluid accumulation around her heart. Big revelation in echo examination When doctors performed TTE and TEE (special heart examinations) on Lakshmi, everyone was surprised to see the report. A large lump of 10x10 cm was present in the right side of the heart. This lump had completely covered the heart valve, preventing proper blood flow in the body. Along with this, the protective membrane above the heart (pericardium) had also thickened to 1 centimeter, much more than normal. Initially, it was considered a tumor. Operation lasted 4 hours on heart-lung machine Considering the critical condition of the patient, the decision for the operation was taken on March 14. Dr. Rakesh Verma and his team of doctors put the girl on a heart-lung machine and started the surgery after stopping her heartbeat. First, the thick and hard membrane accumulated on the heart was separated from the large arteries. After this, the wall of the heart was opened and that huge lump was removed. After the operation, when the lump was biopsied, it was found that it was not a tumor but a TB infection. This rare case will be reported globally Dr. Rakesh Verma, Director of LPS Cardiology, said - such a large lump of TB inside the heart and such thickening of the membrane is extremely rare. He said that he has reviewed national and international medical literature, but no other such case has come to light so far. He said - this is a great achievement for the institute. Currently, the girl is completely healthy and will be discharged from the hospital soon. Team of these doctors performed the successful operation The team that performed this complex surgery included Prof. Rakesh Verma, Dr. Saurabh, Dr. Prabhat, Dr. Sriraj and Dr. Laxman from the surgical department. The anesthesia team included Dr. Chandni, Dr. Suraj, Dr. Urvashi, Dr. Nisha and Dr. Diksha. Dr. Mubeen was in charge of the heart-lung machine, and the nursing staff included Sunita, Vaishali and Anuj. What is a Heart-Lung Machine The heart-lung machine is a life-saving device, also known as the cardiopulmonary bypass (CPB) machine. It is used during open-heart surgery when the heart needs to be stopped. This machine temporarily takes over the heart's pumping and the lungs' oxygenation functions, ensuring blood circulation throughout the body.

stories.title: Mother of 7 seeking divorce brutally murdered by husband:Lover also killed, inside story of double murder in Ghaziabad
stories.summary: Rashid’s mother, Ameer Jahan, has spoken out after her son allegedly murdered his wife and her boyfriend in Ghaziabad. She said, “Rashid was my son, but now he is not. Ever since his marriage, we have lived apart. He even broke my hand, and I cut all ties with him. I have nothing to do with him now.” She added that a year ago, she had disinherited both her sons and their wives, filing an affidavit stating they were no longer her children and that she had no connection with their actions. Ameer Jahan also revealed that Rashid had previously assaulted her, and she had filed a complaint. Rashid has been on the run since the murders, and police are actively searching for him. See 2 pictures Now know the full case in detail Mother of seven children had an affair with husband's friend In Ghaziabad, on the night of March 23, Rashid shot and killed his 36-year-old wife Shabnam and her lover Faheem in Loni's Tronica City. Shabnam was a mother of 7 children. She had been having an affair with her lover Faheem for the past 2 years. Police investigation and questioning of the family revealed that Rashid had seen his wife Shabnam in an objectionable act with her lover Faheem two months ago. After which, he had warned his wife to either leave her lover or face dire consequences. Married 20 years ago Rashid, a resident of Tronica City, Ghaziabad, married Shabnam in 2006. Shabnam has 7 children. Rashid works with bamboo and poles. Faheem, who lived one kilometer away, had also been working with him for 8 years. Rashid's friend Faheem used to visit his house. For about 2 years, Rashid's wife Shabnam developed close relations with Faheem. They started talking on mobile secretly. Occasionally, when Faheem visited his friend Rashid's house, he would also meet his lover Shabnam. Mother said - I have two sons, both beat me Rashid's mother, Ameer Jahan, said - On March 3, 2025, I submitted a complaint letter to the DM Ghaziabad. In it, Rashid's mother stated that she has two sons, Aamir and Rashid. Both of them assault her. Her sons' wives also assault her. The activities of both are not good; they frequently fight and assault within the family. Rashid and his wife Shabnam have 7 children: Rehan 17 years, Zeeshan 15 years, Ayaan 11 years, Ayesha 7 years, Arhaan 6 years, Shifa 4 years, and the youngest daughter is one year old. Rashid's mother, Ameer Jahan, also stated that Rashid's wife Shabnam had broken her hand. She built a house of 50 square yards for one, and bought a 35 square yard plot and built a house for Rashid. But they did not appreciate it, so she ended the relationship. My grandson came and told me Ameer Jahan said that Rashid's son Rehan told her on Tuesday morning that Dad killed Mom and her friend Faheem. They had a fight at night. It has been revealed that first, the father Rashid called his wife's lover Faheem. After that, both of them sat together and drank alcohol. It was there that Rashid shot and killed his wife Shabnam and Faheem. Rashid had married off his 17-year-old son Rehan just 15 days ago. From here, Rashid started feeling that his reputation was being tarnished after his son's marriage. After which, he was continuously explaining to his wife that their son was now married. If this matter reached his son's wife, their reputation would be ruined in the entire community. Mother of 7 children wanted a divorce Police investigation revealed that some time ago, Rashid had registered the house in his wife Shabnam's name. Rashid was continuously trying to convince his wife Shabnam to save his home. He had told his wife Shabnam, "Where will you go now, leaving 7 children?" But Shabnam wanted to divorce her husband Rashid. Two months ago, Rashid locked his wife Shabnam in a room and beat her. In this incident, his elder son Rehan found out that his mother Shabnam had a relationship with Faheem, who used to visit their house. But Rehan did not tell anyone, fearing disgrace to the family. Police investigation revealed that Rashid was afraid that if his wife Shabnam divorced him and lived with his friend Faheem, the house he had bought would also go into his wife's name. On the other hand, after his son's marriage, there would be disgrace that the mother of 7 children would leave her husband and go with her lover. Due to this, Rashid shot and killed his wife Shabnam and her lover. Shabnam had 7 children, 6 were in another house Rashid had built a new house some time ago, where he lived with his wife. The other house is a short distance away. The murder took place in the new house. At the time of the incident, only one son was at home, while the other 6 children were in the other house. All the children are young.

stories.title: Kuldeep Yadav, Vanshika offered prayers at Banke Bihari temple:Cricketer's first visit to Vrindavan after marriage| WATCH
stories.summary: Cricketer Kuldeep Yadav visited Banke Bihari in Vrindavan with his wife Vanshika yesterday. They reached the temple at 7:30 PM on Tuesday. Both served by applying perfume on the threshold (doorframe). Then the couple offered ‘56 bhog’ to the Lord. It was their first visit to Mathura after marriage. Kuldeep arrived in Vrindavan so discreetly that no one even got a whiff of it. People came to know about it on Wednesday morning after photos and videos surfaced. Both stayed in the temple for about 25 minutes. During that period, the temple guards stood beside them and guarded them continuously. Temple priest Shailendra Goswami said that Kuldeep's family had informed them about his arrival. They had requested to keep it confidential to avoid crowd. Upon reaching the temple, Nitin Sanwariya and I performed the worship. We had the threshold worshipped by offering perfume. Then we presented the Lord's blessed garland. Subsequently after staying in Vrindavan for about an hour, the couple left for Delhi. Visuals of Kuldeep-Vanshika from Banke Bihari temple - Kuldeep Yadav became a cricketer because of his father Kuldeep was born on December 14, 1994, in a village in Unnao district. His father ran a brick kiln while his mother, Usha Yadav, is a housewife. He has 3 elder sisters. Kuldeep had a tremendous passion for cricket early in his childhood and would never miss watching matches whenever they were broadcast on TV. Kuldeep had mentioned in an interview that his father wanted to make him a cricketer, but he didn't like this game at all. He just used to play cricket with a tennis ball with friends. He was quite good in studies. Today, because of his father's hard work, he has become the charismatic off-spinner of Indian cricket.

stories.title: Tragic house collapse after cylinder explosion in Varanasi:Family’s wedding preparations are shattered; mother and elder son survive while 2 children die
stories.summary: In Varanasi’s Lahartara area, a gas cylinder exploded on March 24 while a family was cooking, causing their house to collapse. A brother and sister, trapped under the debris, died in the accident. Their mother and elder brother were injured and taken to a trauma centre. Dainik Bhaskar visited the site and spoke to locals, who described the tragic incident. The victims were identified as 31-year-old Om Kumar Chaudhary and 28-year-old Preeti alias Lakshmi. Their mother, 60-year-old Girija Devi, and elder brother, 36-year-old Aman Kumar Chaudhary, are receiving treatment for serious injuries. Relatives of the family shared details about their lives. Girija Devi’s husband, Atma Prasad, had passed away three years ago. Om worked as a car driver, while Aman delivered water near Cantt Station. The family depended on both sons for their livelihood. Before the tragedy, Aman had refused to marry, and Girija Devi was seeking marriage proposals for Om and Preeti. Many matches were considered for Om, but fate took a tragic turn with the accident. Read the report First, see 3 pictures Niece said - Wedding preparations were underway at home Chanda, niece of Girja Devi who lives in the neighborhood, said - We were sleeping. Suddenly, we woke up hearing the sound of an explosion. We ran outside and saw that Badi Mummy's house had collapsed. By then, neighbors had also arrived. We asked people to search for the family members. Then we called the police. The electricity connection was cut. Chanda says - Badi Mummy had two sons, Aman and Om Bhaiya. Aman Bhaiya is quite weak. Badi Maa asked him about marriage, but he refused. That's why she was looking for a match for Om Bhaiya. She had also seen one or two girls for Om Bhaiya. Wedding preparations were underway, but fate had something else in store. Relatives said - She had dreams of marrying off her daughter Preeti Girja Devi is admitted to the trauma center. One of her relatives told off-camera - Girja Devi was also worried about Preeti's marriage. She used to say repeatedly, 'After Om's marriage, I will marry off Preeti.' But today, the same son and daughter, whom she trusted to be her support in old age, were swallowed by the jaws of death together. Cousin said - Brother and sister were buried under the debris Aman's cousin Rohit said - My elder father had a copy-book shop near Cantt station until a few years ago. He died in the year 2023. This morning, suddenly around 7:30 AM, there was an explosion. We were sleeping. When we went outside, there was dust everywhere. When the dust cleared, two people were visible in the debris. They were Aman and Preeti, but both had already died. Aunt kept crying, sitting in the street Om and Preeti's aunt and her daughters cried inconsolably. Women of the neighborhood said - Girija Devi is very friendly. The children also mingle with people. Perhaps this was what fate had intended today. Now, the complete incident in sequence In Varanasi, on March 24, at 7:27 AM, a gas cylinder exploded while making tea. The entire house collapsed due to the blast. At the time of the accident, 4 family members were present in the house. Among them, a brother and sister died. The mother and elder brother were injured after being trapped under the debris. The blast was so severe that cracks appeared in many nearby houses. People came out of their homes. They rushed to help. Police, who arrived at the scene, rescued people trapped in the debris and sent them to BHU Trauma Center. 50-year-old house collapsed Girija's house is about 50 years old. The back part was recently built. Its finishing work was going on. The front 400 sq ft part was dilapidated. At the time of the accident, everyone was in this part. In the morning, Girija Devi was cooking in the kitchen. Suddenly, gas started leaking from the cylinder. The pipe caught fire. Before she could understand anything, there was a loud explosion and the house collapsed.

stories.title: Raj intelligence nabs UP man spying for Pak:Father publicly disowns son; calls him a traitor and demands strict punishment
stories.summary: Sumit hasn’t returned home for 11 years and rarely speaks to his family. Whenever his mother called, he would just say, “I’m busy” and hang up. His father, Benimadhav from Lahurpar village in Prayagraj, said, “He has betrayed the country. The law will punish him. We don’t know when or how he did this. We have nothing to do with him.” On March 23, Rajasthan Intelligence arrested Sumit from Chabua Air Force Station in Assam. He was working there as an MTS (Multi-Tasking Staff). Authorities say he was sharing sensitive Indian Air Force information with Pakistani handlers, including details about fighter jets, missile systems, and officers. The same day, Sumit was presented in the CJM Court Metropolitan First in Rajasthan. The court approved a 12-day remand, keeping him in custody until April 2. To know more about Sumit’s family, his job, and their reaction to his arrest, the Dainik Bhaskar team visited Lahurpar village, 16 km from the district headquarters, and spoke to his relatives. Read the report He is my son, so there is pain in my heart, but the family has no relation to him Benimadhav said that he is his son, he gave birth to him. That's why he is naturally worried about him. There is pain in my heart over the condition of the child I raised. I cannot hide it. But what he did, he did not do well. He shamed us. Why did he do this? For what reason? We don't know anything about this. The family has nothing to do with any of his actions. He informed that he has been caught on charges of spying for Pakistan. We got this information from the news. When we saw his photo, we were stunned. Villagers also told us about him. Father said- An officer took Sumit to Assam The father stated that Sumit is the third of his five sons. The eldest is Ramraj, the second is Ramsharan, and the youngest is Rajneesh. All of them reside in the village. The three sons living in the village work as milk vendors. Ramraj and Ramsharan are married, while Rajneesh is unmarried. The fourth son, Rajkumar, is posted in the Air Force in a Class IV position in Ladakh. He mentioned that the Air Force campus is located a short distance from his house. I used to deliver milk to the officers' residences there. Sumit would also accompany me then. It was during this time that he came into contact with an officer. That officer was transferred in 2011. He took Sumit with him to Assam. Subsequently, he helped him secure a job there. For a few years, things were fine, but then he stopped visiting. He even reduced communication with his family. After much persuasion, he came to attend a community feast (bhandara) held at home in 2015. His wife and 12-year-old son were also with him. After this, he never returned. He stopped answering calls. Sister-in-law said that Sumit did not even come to his brother's wedding She said that my family's financial situation is not hidden from anyone. After getting the job, Sumit's behaviour changed. He never helped with even a single rupee. I support the family by selling milk. All three sons help in this. Sumit's sister-in-law, Rani, said that Sumit's brother Rajkumar got married in 2018. We gave him a card. We also called him. But he didn't come. During his job, he was transferred to Shillong. Here he married a girl. Then, after a few days, Sumit was transferred to Assam. But his wife did not go with him. We have no contact with Sumit.

stories.title: Fresh western disturbance to hit UP:5 days of rain and hail likely; cold winds may bring sharp 4–5°C fall
stories.summary: The weather in UP is about to deteriorate again. The spell of storms and rain that began last week will continue until the end of March. The Meteorological Department has predicted the possibility of two different weather systems across the state between March 26 and 30. This will bring rain with thunder and lightning. Hail may fall in some places. Cold winds will blow. The temperature will drop by 4 °C to 5 °C. However, the weather may remain clear today. For the past 2 days, only light rain has occurred in some parts of the state. This led to a 3 °C to 5 °C increase in temperature. In the last 24 hours, Banda was the hottest, with a maximum temperature of 35.2 °C. The mercury was 34.6 °C in Prayagraj and 34.4 °C in Varanasi. The lowest temperature was recorded in Bijnor at 14 °C. Lucknow's meteorologist, Atul Kumar Singh, stated- Two western disturbances are becoming active in the state. This will create a possibility of rain across the entire state. Drizzle will begin in Western UP from March 26. Its effect will reach Eastern UP. Meanwhile, the disturbance becoming active on March 29 is being assessed as more powerful. This will bring good rain across the entire state. There will be a significant drop in temperature. A feeling of cold will be experienced. How will the weather be for the next 5 days? Why are there fluctuations in the weather? The Meteorological Department says that the weather in the hills of Uttarakhand is constantly changing. A rain and snowfall alert has been issued for the next 2 to 3 days. Its direct impact will be seen in UP. Cold winds coming from the mountains will make you feel cold. Government said - if crops fall, farmers can claim insurance For farmers whose crops have been damaged by the rain and hailstorms in recent days, there is good news. According to the government, if crops are damaged within 14 days of harvesting, farmers can claim insurance under the Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana. The district administration will survey the crop damage due to natural calamities and submit a report, based on which the UP government may decide to provide compensation. stories.title: Harish Rana’s last rites held after euthanasia:Father breaks down; requests no one to cry as his son leaves in peace
stories.summary: The mortal remains of Harish Rana from Ghaziabad were brought to Delhi’s Green Park crematorium at 8:30 AM on Wednesday for his last rites. His cremation is expected to take place shortly. During this time, his father folded his hands and appealed to people not to cry, saying his son should leave in peace. Harish Rana passed away at Delhi AIIMS on March 24. The 31-year-old had been in a coma for the past 13 years. The Supreme Court had granted permission for euthanasia on March 11, making it the first such case in the country. Earlier, the family donated Harish’s heart valves and corneas. AIIMS confirmed that he died at 4:10 PM on Tuesday. He was admitted to the Oncology Department (IRCH), where Dr Seema Mishra was treating him. Harish was given passive euthanasia at AIIMS. This means that life support or medical treatment used to keep a seriously ill patient alive is withdrawn, allowing the person to die naturally. Was shifted to Delhi AIIMS on March 14 Accident in 2013, Harish fell from the fourth floor of the hostel Supreme Court delivered the verdict on March 11 The Supreme Court gave its verdict on March 11 in the euthanasia case. The court had granted permission for passive euthanasia to Harish Rana, who had been in a coma for 13 years. Euthanasia received legal recognition in 2018 In 2005, an NGO named Common Cause filed a petition in the Supreme Court demanding the right to passive euthanasia. On March 9, 2018, a 5-judge bench led by CJI Deepak Mishra gave legal recognition to euthanasia. The Supreme Court had then said, If a patient has an incurable disease or is in a vegetative state, surviving only on life support system, their treatment can be discontinued for natural death. This will not be considered euthanasia, but rather the right to die with dignity. This right is part of Article 21 of the Constitution, which includes the right to die with dignity along with the right to live with dignity.

stories.title: Gorakhpur to get floating solar plant:20 megawatts of power generation planned
stories.summary: The Yogi Cabinet on March 23 approved setting up a floating solar power plant in Gorakhpur. The floating plant will be installed on Chilua Tal and will have a capacity of 20 megawatts. Electricity generated from it will be used by residents of Gorakhpur. This raises key questions—solar plants can be set up on land, so why build them on a lake? How do heavy solar panels float? How safe is it to have water and electricity together? Here’s an explainer. Question- How is a floating solar power plant built on water? Answer- In a floating solar plant, solar panels are mounted on plastic-based platforms called floaters and placed on the surface of a lake. These floaters are designed to carry up to 2.5 times their own weight. To ensure stability during fluctuations in water level or strong winds, the floaters are anchored to the lakebed. The entire structure is made using corrosion-resistant materials. The solar panels used are also specially designed. Unlike regular panels, they do not use lead and are equipped with enhanced waterproofing since they remain in constant contact with water. Electricity generated is transmitted to the grid through insulated underwater cables, which connect to inverters installed on the banks before feeding into the main grid. Question - Why was it necessary to install the solar plant in the lake? Answer- A 20 MW solar plant requires around 100 to 120 acres of land, which then cannot be used for farming or construction. Additionally, land-based solar plants are often set up in remote areas, increasing costs of infrastructure, transmission, operations and maintenance. In hilly regions, the cost rises even further. Considering these factors, water bodies like lakes offer an alternative, allowing land to be used for productive purposes such as agriculture, housing or tourism. Question- Is this better than land-based plants? Answer- Yes. Research shows that floating solar plants can generate up to 10% more electricity than land-based ones. This is because panels remain cooler due to the surrounding water, improving efficiency. On land, high temperatures often reduce panel performance. Question- Can floating solar plants be installed in rivers and seas as well? Answer- Generally, floating solar plants are installed on lakes and reservoirs where water is relatively still. Rivers and seas have strong waves, which would significantly increase design complexity and operational costs. Floating plants on reservoirs linked to hydroelectric projects are more economical, as existing grid connections and infrastructure can be used, reducing overall costs. Question- Are there any existing floating solar power plants in UP? Answer- Yes. Two floating solar plants are already operational in the state. A 20 MW plant in Dibiyapur, Auraiya, built by NTPC, was the first. Another 11 MW plant operates in Khurja, Bulandshahr. The state is now setting up a 20 MW plant at Chilua Tal in Gorakhpur through Coal India. A 49 MW project has also been proposed in Lalitpur. Question - Are floating solar plants operating in other states? Answer- Yes. India’s largest floating solar plant, with a capacity of 100 MW, was commissioned in July 2022 at Ramagundam in Telangana. The second largest, with 92 MW capacity, began operations in August 2022 at Kayamkulam in Kerala. In Madhya Pradesh, a 600 MW floating solar project is being developed on the Omkareshwar Dam on the Narmada River, which is expected to be the world’s largest. Question - What are the challenges of installing floating solar power plants? Answer- The biggest challenge is cost. Specialised equipment and skilled technicians are required. Anchoring and stabilising floaters is technically complex, increasing engineering and construction expenses. Safety is another concern, as electricity and water coexist. Underwater cables require rigorous insulation testing. Although extensive research has been conducted, uncertainties remain—especially regarding performance in extremely cold regions like Kashmir and Ladakh, where lakes may freeze. Question- Why can't we generate all electricity from solar by shutting down power plants? Answer- Solar energy depends on sunlight. During rain, cloudy weather or winters, power generation can drop by 10% to 50%. Another issue is grid capacity—only a fixed amount of energy can be stored and transmitted. stories.title: UP polls likely in January 2027:BJP eyes third term as SP, BSP and Congress look to stage comeback
stories.summary: Uttar Pradesh has entered an election year as the Yogi Adityanath-led government completed four years of its second term on March 25. Trends indicate that the Model Code of Conduct may come into effect in January 2027. Voting is expected to take place in seven phases, and by the second week of March 2027, it will be clear whether the BJP secures a third consecutive term or loses power. The term of BJP's Yogi government is till May 22, 2027. Elections will have to be held before that. What is BJP's strategy for the elections? How will it deal with the challenges of the election year? What are the challenges before Samajwadi Party, BSP, and Congress? Read in this report… 2022 elections: BJP lost seats, Samajwadi Party emerged stronger In the 2022 Assembly elections, BJP and its allies won 273 seats with a 41% vote share. Compared to 2017, when BJP had secured 325 seats, this marked a loss of 52 seats. The Samajwadi Party (SP) significantly improved its performance, increasing its seat count from 47 to 111 with a 32% vote share. The Bahujan Samaj Party (BSP) secured 12.88% votes but won only one seat, while Congress managed just two seats. Smaller parties such as Apna Dal (S) (12 MLAs) and Nishad Party (6 MLAs) played a crucial role in maintaining the stability of the BJP government. According to party sources, preparations will intensify after the final voter list is released. Committees will be formed at over 15,000 new booths. The campaign strategy will combine development and Hindutva. Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath will lead the narrative, while the party organization strengthens its groundwork from booth level to the state level. Key challenges before BJP The party is also attempting to consolidate the Hindu vote bank through messaging focused on unity. By-Elections Changed the Political Equation After suffering losses in the 2024 Lok Sabha elections—losing 29 seats and witnessing an 8% drop in vote share—BJP made a comeback by winning 7 out of 9 Assembly bypoll seats. In 2025, BJP also won the Milkipur by-election in Ayodhya. However, it lost the Ghosi by-election. Currently, BJP’s MLA count has increased to 257, while SP’s tally has decreased from 111 to 102. Experts credit Yogi government for law order Senior journalist Virendranath Bhatt said the Yogi government has set milestones in improving law and order and ensured political stability in the state. He added that traditional issues such as electricity, sugarcane, and agriculture have taken a backseat, while development projects like Jewar Airport, the Ganga Expressway, and the Ram Temple in Ayodhya dominate the narrative. Five major challenges faced by the government Samajwadi strengthening its social coalition strategy The Samajwadi Party has been strengthening its PDA (Backward, Dalit, Minority) strategy, which helped the SP-Congress alliance win 43 Lok Sabha seats in 2024. In terms of Assembly segments, the alliance led in 217 seats, compared to NDA’s 180. However, SP faces challenges due to limited support among upper castes and the absence of strong regional allies apart from Congress. BSP attempts to regain ground The BSP, whose vote share dropped below 10% in the 2024 Lok Sabha elections, is trying to revive its base. Under Mayawati, the party has begun early candidate selection and is working to rebuild a coalition of Dalits, Brahmins, Muslims, and backward classes. However, it lacks strong leadership representation among OBCs, Muslims, and upper castes, and its grassroots activity remains limited. Congress active but organizationally weak Congress has shown increased activity after its alliance with SP in 2024, improving its electoral performance. However, its biggest weakness remains the lack of a strong organizational structure at the grassroots level. Despite active leadership, the party struggles to convert issues into large-scale movements. Regional parties eye greater influence Regional parties like Apna Dal (S), RLD, SBSP, and Nishad Party together hold 33 MLAs and are actively expanding their base through rallies and public outreach. Their aim is to strengthen their bargaining power and secure a larger share of seats in alliances.

stories.title: IPL match in Lucknow today:Metro services till late night, traffic diversion in place; check routes before stepping out
stories.summary: The administration in Lucknow is on alert today for the IPL 2026 match. While metro service timings have been extended, traffic diversions have also been implemented on key city routes during the match. Metro services extended till late night Uttar Pradesh Metro Rail Corporation has extended metro operations till 12:30 am for the convenience of cricket fans. The decision has been taken in view of the home match of Lucknow Super Giants, so that spectators do not face difficulty returning home after the match. Easy connectivity to Ekana Stadium To reach Bharat Ratna Shri Atal Bihari Vajpayee Ekana Cricket Stadium, feeder buses are being operated every 15 minutes from Indira Nagar and Transport Nagar metro stations from 3 pm. These buses will continue to run after the match as well. Strict measures on Shaheed Path, heavy vehicles banned Traffic diversion will remain in force on Shaheed Path during the match. Entry of heavy vehicles, roadways and private buses has been completely restricted. Autos and e-rickshaws will also not be allowed on this route. Special arrangements for city buses towards the stadium Only city buses heading towards the stadium have been permitted. Buses will not be allowed to stop between Husadiya and Sushant Golf City and will operate in the right lane of the road. Stopping on service roads will be restricted, and e-rickshaws will also be banned there. Route plan for small vehicles Traffic police have prepared separate routes for autos, e-rickshaws and cabs. Vehicles coming from Arjunganj will be diverted from Ahimamau. Temporary drop-off arrangements have been made near PHQ, UP-112 and behind the maternity hospital. Vehicles coming from Sultanpur Road will drop passengers near Lulu Mall. Pick-and-drop will be completely banned within a 500-metre radius of Ahimamau. Parking plan for private vehicles Pass holders will have to park their vehicles via HCL and Water Tank Tiraha at designated parking spots. Those without passes will first park at Palassio Mall, then at alternative locations, while two-wheelers will be parked behind Palassio Mall. Entry and timing Entry will begin three hours before the match. Spectators will be allowed entry only till the middle of the second innings. Re-entry will not be permitted after exit. Police have warned of strict action for violation of rules and advised people to check the traffic plan before leaving home. Plan for heavy vehicles On April 1, traffic diversion for heavy vehicles, buses, commercial vehicles and general traffic will be in place from 3 pm in view of the IPL match at Ekana Stadium. These vehicles will follow designated alternative routes.

stories.title: Sisters-in-law clear PCS exam together in Prayagraj:Supported each other, husband says parents treated daughter-in-law as their own daughter
stories.summary: Aakriti Shukla from Prayagraj appeared for the UPPCS examination twice but could not clear the prelims on both occasions. During this time, her brother Amit got married, and Shreya Sharma became part of the family. Shreya was also preparing for UPPCS. The two became each other’s support system. Shreya helped Aakriti with her weaker subjects, while Aakriti assisted Shreya in areas she found difficult. Their in-laws treated Shreya like their own daughter and kept both Aakriti and Shreya free from household responsibilities. As a result, in the UPPCS-2024 results, Aakriti Shukla became a Deputy SP, while Shreya was selected as a Commercial Tax Officer. There is a celebratory atmosphere in the family, but many are curious about how the two supported each other to achieve success. Dainik Bhaskar spoke to their family members. Here is the story in sequence… Ancestral home in Jaunpur, family now living in Prayagraj The family lives in the Mumfordganj area of Prayagraj. Aakriti’s father, Akhilesh Shukla, originally belongs to Barji Kala village in Sujanganj, Jaunpur. He worked as a senior auditor in the Controller of Defence Accounts office and later settled in Prayagraj. The family includes his wife, son Amit, and daughter Aakriti. His two elder brothers also served in government jobs and live nearby, creating a long-standing academic environment at home. Akhilesh said that since government jobs were common in the family, a culture of studying was already present. He always supported his children in their educational choices, ensuring they pursued meaningful studies. Aakriti completed her early education at St Mary’s Convent and later did a BSc from Allahabad University. She then began preparing for competitive exams and also pursued a law degree from a state university. Attempted UPSC 2 times, did not succeed Shreya Sharma, Aakriti’s sister-in-law, is currently posted as an auditor in the PAG office in Bengaluru, Karnataka, where she lives with her husband Amit, an AI engineer. Shreya said she is originally from Ashiyana in Lucknow and studied at La Martiniere College. She completed her electrical engineering from Dr APJ Abdul Kalam Technical University in 2019 and then decided to prepare for civil services. Her father worked in the Railways, and her brother Shubham, a software engineer, motivated her throughout. She appeared for UPSC twice but did not succeed. Later, she shifted her focus to the UPPCS exam. She cleared the prelims in 2023, raising hopes, but could not clear the mains, which left her disappointed. Sister-in-law failed prelims twice, so confidence decreased Asked how she continued preparation after marriage, Shreya said she married Amit on 20 February 2025 and continued studying even while living at her in-laws’ house in Prayagraj. She never felt like she was in a different home. She said she studied there just as she used to in Lucknow, and the best part was finding a companion in her sister-in-law Akriti. A healthy competition developed between them, and they began helping each other in writing skills as well as difficult subjects. Sister-in-law's support was like a friend, it was helpful When asked how helpful this was, Shreya said that Akriti had appeared twice for UPPCS but failed at the prelim stage both times, which had affected her confidence. The family encouraged her, with her father reminding her that success requires extra effort. With Shreya joining the household, Akriti’s confidence improved. The two began living like friends, which also helped in their studies. Amit says it is a matter of pride that both his sister and wife became officers, setting an example for those who do not treat daughters-in-law like daughters. Husband said - At home, mom and dad considered the daughter-in-law as a daughter Speaking about the family environment, Amit Shukla said there was never any pressure in the house. When Shreya came, his parents treated her like their own daughter. He said Shreya was given the same freedom as Akriti, and both managed household work as per their convenience, with their mother often helping. Their father always encouraged them to focus on studies. Amit added that at the time of their marriage, both Akriti and Shreya had appeared for the prelims and qualified for the mains. They prepared notes together and did not require any specific coaching, as they helped each other. Both cleared the mains as well, which was a first. The family was confident of their selection, though the two remained nervous, which was natural. Akriti got the third rank, Shreya got the 37th rank On the night of March 29, the UPPCS results were announced. Akriti Shukla became Deputy SP. She secured the third rank in the Deputy SP list. Shreya Sharma became a Commercial Tax Officer. She secured the 37th rank in her category. As soon as the rest of the family received the news, everyone rejoiced. Akhilesh Shukla said- Our big dream has come true. In a single day, both daughter and daughter-in-law brought glory. May every home have such daughters.

stories.title: ‘Amitabh Bachchan has one kidney, you’ll be fine’:8th pass mastermind tricks student into kidney donation; operations held in Kanpur
stories.summary: 'My father passed away 2 years ago. There is my mother and one sister at home. The responsibility of my sister's education and marriage is on me. I was not even able to pay my college fees. I saw my future going into darkness. During this time, I met Shivam Agarwal. He motivated me to donate a kidney. Shivam used to say that film actor Amitabh Bachchan has been alive for 43 years thanks to one kidney. Even at the age of 83, he is working in films. Both of Premanand Maharaj's kidneys are also damaged, nothing happened to him either I started to find Shivam, the ambulance driver's words, convincing. He used to say that if you are the sole support of your family, you can pull your family out of the clutches of poverty in exchange for one kidney. I decided to sell my kidney to give my family a good life.' This was stated by Ayush, an MBA fourth-year student from Samastipur, Bihar, who allegedly became a victim in the Kanpur kidney racket. Ayush, who donated his kidney, is currently admitted to Hallet Hospital. Before that, he was undergoing treatment at Med Life Hospital, where he narrated his ordeal to IPS officer Sumedh Jadhav. According to police, six accused, including Shivam Agarwal, have been arrested in the case. Shivam, who studied up to Class 8 and worked as an ambulance driver, is said to be the mastermind of the gang. Now read what Ayush, the kidney donor, revealed If you sell a kidney, you will get the desired price Ayush said that one of Shivam Agarwal’s associates told him that he would get any price for selling a kidney. He also showed him a chat written in a Telegram group, which mentioned that a woman with B+ blood group needed a kidney. It was the same person who introduced him to Shivam. Sell a kidney, all your sorrows and pains will go away Shivam brainwashed me. He took all information about my family and then said that if I sold one kidney, all my problems would end. I told him I would think about it. After that, Shivam kept sending me messages and making phone calls. A few days later, I met him again and refused to donate my kidney. He then asked what the problem was—whether I was scared and why I was worried. He said that Amitabh Bachchan was injured during the film ‘Coolie’, and one of his kidneys got infected, yet he is still completely fit and working in films. He also said that Premanand Maharaj’s both kidneys are damaged, yet he is fine. He told me that I am young and nothing would happen if I donated one kidney. Made an excuse to family about going to give exams Ayush said that after being convinced by Shivam, he decided to donate his kidney. After three days, when he called Shivam, he was asked to come to Ahuja Hospital. On reaching the hospital, he was told he would get ₹5 lakh. When he refused, the amount was increased and later fixed at ₹9.50 lakh. His operation was conducted on the night of March 29. He had lied to his family and come to Kanpur, telling his mother that he was going to appear for an exam and would return in three days. Now know the full story Late on the night of March 30 (Monday), police busted an illegal kidney transplant racket in Kanpur. A 23-year-old MBA student from Bihar was paid ₹6 lakh for his kidney, which was later sold to a 30-year-old woman patient for around ₹80 lakh. After the student complained to the police, raids were conducted the same night at Med Life Hospital, Ahuja Hospital and Priya Hospital. At Med Life Hospital, both the kidney donor Ayush and the patient were found admitted. When documents related to the transplant were sought, the hospital failed to produce any valid papers. On March 31 (Tuesday), police arrested Ahuja Hospital owner Dr Preeti Ahuja, her husband Dr Surjeet, Dr Rajesh Kumar, Dr Ram Prakash, Dr Narendra Singh and agent Shivam Agarwal and sent them to jail. Now know what is the connection between the 6 accused? How did the syndicate work? Gathered information of dialysis patients, shared on Telegram Police Commissioner Raghubir Lal said the syndicate worked in an organised manner. Dr Afzal collected details of long-term dialysis patients through hospital contacts and approached them for transplants. Patient details were then shared in Telegram groups, which included doctors and agents. Parul Tomar, wife of a school operator from Muzaffarnagar, was contacted by Dr Afzal. Parul had been undergoing dialysis for 8 years Parul had been on dialysis for the past eight years and agreed to the transplant after contact with Dr Afzal. Initial investigation revealed that the deal was fixed at ₹80 lakh. Her details were shared on Telegram, stating that a 30-year-old woman with B+ blood group needed a kidney and the donor would get a high price. This is how Ayush came in contact with Shivam. After the operation at Ahuja Hospital on Sunday, Parul was admitted to Priya Hospital. She is now being treated at Hallet Hospital. Shivam himself used to find and bring donors Police Commissioner Raghubir Lal said that after the deal was finalised, Shivam contacted Dr Rohit, who brought a team of 7–8 doctors from Delhi and Lucknow, including specialists in anaesthesia, surgery and medicine. After the operation, donor and recipient were shifted to separate hospitals, where they were kept under observation for 4–5 days before discharge. In case of complications, patients were referred to higher centres in Lucknow and Delhi. The entire setup was prepared in a cinematic style During police interrogation, Shivam said 7–8 operations had been conducted at Ahuja Hospital and similar illegal transplants were carried out in around seven hospitals in Kanpur and Lucknow. All operations were conducted at night, and both donor and recipient were admitted three days in advance. CCTVs used to be turned off Dr Rohit fixed the date and time of operations, which were conducted only at night. If families hesitated, they were told the doctor was unavailable during the day. Before the team arrived, CCTV cameras were switched off. Hospital staff were sent on leave on the day of surgery, and only Dr Rohit’s team remained inside. All medicines and arrangements were handled by the team. After surgery, donor and recipient were shifted early morning to different hospitals without documentation. Shivam transported them in his ambulance. 7 hospitals in Kanpur-Lucknow on police radar On the evening of March 31, Med Life Hospital was sealed, while Ahuja Hospital was issued a notice and will also be sealed. Priya Hospital has also been served a notice seeking a reply. Police Commissioner Raghubir Lal said that initial investigation has revealed that more than 50 illegal kidney transplants have been conducted in Kanpur so far. Dr Rohit has also performed operations at other locations in Kanpur and is in contact with doctors in Delhi. In connection with the kidney transplant case, seven hospitals—one in Lucknow and six in Kanpur—are under the scanner.

stories.title: 14,000 PNG consumers surrender LPG connections:Surge in applications for pipeline connections; transfer requests rise by 100%
stories.summary: In Agra, as the number of PNG consumers rises, the trend of surrendering LPG connections has also begun. So far, 14,000 PNG users have surrendered their LPG connections. This step has been taken following instructions from the Petroleum Ministry and due to a shortage of domestic cylinders. Green Gas Company had sent a list of 75,000 PNG consumers to oil companies. Out of these, 14,000 consumers have surrendered their LPG connections so far. The highest number—around 8,000—belongs to Indian Oil Corporation (IOC). Trend of LPG connection surrender begins Applications for LPG connection transfers have increased by 100 percent. Under existing rules, domestic cylinders can be booked every 25 days in urban areas and every 45 days in rural areas. In view of this, LPG consumers have found a middle path. Gas agencies are also facing pressure to issue new connections. The district has 84 gas agencies with 1.357 million consumers, including 700,000 under IOC. Earlier, around 10 to 15 applications were received per week, but now the number has doubled. A gas agency operator said most consumers are applying for agencies closer to their homes, which could further increase difficulties. Consumers have already booked cylinders before applying, meaning they will not receive another cylinder for the next 45 days. Applications for LPG connection transfers have increased by 100 percent. stories.title: Maulana who abused Yogi’s mother, seen limping:Seeks apology, says ‘CM sir, galti ho gai’; sent to Bahraich jail
stories.summary: Maulana Abdul Salim Chaturvedi, who used abusive words against CM Yogi's mother, was sent to Bahraich jail on Tuesday afternoon. The City Magistrate Rajesh confirmed this. After about 30 minutes of questioning at the police station, the police took him to jail. During this time, Maulana was seen limping and walking with a bend. Police personnel were seen supporting him. He had worn a mask on his face. A video has emerged after Maulana's arrest. In this, he is seen apologizing with folded hands. He is saying that during the speech, some objectionable things came out of my tongue, which should not have come out. For this, I sincerely apologize to the CM and his mother. UP STF had arrested him from Purnea Maulana was arrested by the UP STF from Purnia on Monday. Bihar's Amour seat MLA Akhtar-ul-Iman had confirmed this. He said that STF informed him that Maulana was taken into custody under legal process. The Maulana had made this indecent remark about 2 years ago, the video of which went viral on March 6. After this, Hindu organizations and BJP workers demonstrated in many districts, including Lucknow in UP, and demanded action. Complaints were filed against the Maulana in several districts, including Balrampur and Bahraich. On March 8, Ajit Pratap Singh, district president of Vishwa Hindu Parishad's legal cell, filed a case at Bahraich Kotwali. Police had brought him for questioning in this case. Maulana assured that such mistake will not happen again Maulana said that on May 5, 2024, an educational awareness conference was held in the Meeran Chak area of Bhagalpur, Bihar. During his speech, some objectionable words came out of his mouth. He said that he made a mistake and assured that such a mistake will not happen again in the future. He appealed to people not to say anything in speeches that would hurt the sentiments of any person or religion and spoil the atmosphere of society. AIMIM MLA had informed about the arrest Maulana Salim has been associated with AIMIM. On Monday, party's Amour MLA Akhterul Iman said that late Monday evening, some people picked up Maulana from Dalmalpur Chowk in Purnia district. According to Akhterul Iman, he first spoke to the station in-charge of the district regarding this matter. They spoke with UP STF. The STF informed that the Maulana was taken by the police under legal procedure. They also informed the district SP about this. However, Bihar Police said they had no information about this action. Maulana's clarification- Old statement edited and made viral In the matter, the Maulana issued a video giving clarification. He said, My old statement has been edited and made viral in a cut-shortened form. The statement is being presented in the wrong context in an attempt to defame me. After Maulana's clarification, his supporters had demanded an impartial investigation of the entire matter. Protests against Maulana in Lucknow... Protests were held in Lucknow, Balrampur, and other districts in UP over Maulana's remarks. BJP leader and UP Women's Commission Vice President Aparna Bisht Yadav had said that the status of a mother is very high in any religion. Even in Islam, the mother is given a very high status, but this Maulana has not read such teachings. He should stop making such vulgar comments and should apologize.

stories.title: IAS officer, who suffered gun shots and public humiliation, resigns:Rahi alleges he wasn't assigned any work for past 8 months
stories.summary: UP IAS officer Rinku Singh Rahi has resigned from service, calling it a ‘moral decision’. Rahi was transferred from Shahjahanpur to the Revenue Council eight months ago and had not been given a field posting since. At the time of his transfer, he was serving as SDM of Puwayan tehsil. He had earlier sparked controversy after making a clerk do squats for defecating in the open. Following protests by lawyers, he softened his stance and performed squats himself. He was later removed after the video surfaced. A 42-year-old 2022-batch IAS officer, Rahi, had survived a shooting during the BSP regime on March 26, 2009. He was hit by seven bullets, including two in the face, leaving him disfigured. One ear was damaged, and he lost vision in one eye. Know who is Rinku Singh Rahi... He was shot 7 times for exposing corruption Rinku Singh Rahi was born in Hathras. He completed his education till intermediate. Then did B.Tech from Jamshedpur. In 2004, he cleared PCS and was appointed as District Social Welfare Officer in 2008. His first posting as District Social Welfare Officer was in Muzaffarnagar. During his posting here, he exposed corruption in scholarship and pension schemes. At that time, there was a BSP government. On March 26, 2009, while he was playing badminton with a colleague, two attackers fired multiple shots at him. Rinku Rahi was hit by seven bullets, two of which struck her face. Her jaw was dislocated, and her face was disfigured. Additionally, one ear was damaged, and she lost vision in one eye. Hospitalized for one month, held protest After this attack, Rinku was taken to the higher center in Meerut. She remained admitted at Subharti Medical College, Meerut, for about a month. After surgery, she returned for recovery. Following this, to expose the scam, Rinku had requested some information from the department under RTI, but even after a year, the information was not provided. On March 26, 2012, Rinku Rahi began a hunger strike outside the Lucknow Directorate. Police picked up Rinku Rahi from there and sent him to the Mental Hospital in Lucknow. However, he later got relief. Took UPSC Civil Services Exam under disability quota IAS officer Rinku Singh Rahi took the UPSC Civil Services exam under the disability quota. He passed the exam with 683 rank in 2021. He is an IAS officer of the 2022 batch, UP cadre. 24 candidates from various coaching programs run by the Uttar Pradesh government were successful. Rinku Singh was among them. He is from Hathras. Due to the poor financial condition of the family, Rinku Singh completed his education from a government school. After passing 12th with good marks, he received a scholarship. With this, he completed B.Tech from the Tata Institute.

stories.title: 4 members of a family found dead in Muzaffarnagar:Husband was hanging from noose, wife and two children dead inside room
stories.summary: Four members of a family were found dead inside a room in Muzaffarnagar. The room was locked from inside. When police broke open the door around 11 am on Tuesday, the husband was found hanging, while the wife and two children were lying on the floor. The son was two years old, and the daughter was just one month old. Family members said the couple had been arguing since the second day of Eid (March 22). The dispute began after the husband gave ₹1700 as Eidi to his sister, which upset the wife. The argument continued till around 4 am on Tuesday. By morning, the bodies of the husband, wife, and both children were found inside the room. The couple had been married for five years. SSP Sanjay Kumar Verma said the initial investigation suggests the husband killed his wife and children before taking his own life. Suspicion arose when the house remained closed for a long time on Tuesday morning. Neighbours called a relative, and the door was opened in the presence of the police. The case is from the Civil Lines police station area. Panic spread after four bodies of a family were found inside a locked room. In Gali No. 6 of the Sarwat area, Irshad (32) lived with his wife Noreen (28), their two-year-old son Aahil, and their one-month-old daughter Aksha. Irshad worked as a painter. On Tuesday morning, when the door of his house did not open for a long time, neighbours called his brother Naushad. When Naushad went inside, all four were found dead. He immediately informed the police. On receiving information about four deaths at one place, Civil Lines SHO Ashutosh Kumar reached the spot with a police team. SSP Sanjay Kumar Verma, ASP Siddharth K. Mishra, CO Mandi Raju Kumar Sav, along with the dog squad, LIU, and forensic teams, also reached and began an investigation. A crowd gathered outside Irshad’s house as news of the incident spread. Questioning of neighbours and relatives Police questioned neighbours and relatives to piece together the sequence of events. Officials said further action will be taken based on the post-mortem report and other evidence. Family members told police that Irshad’s sister had recently visited and he gave her ₹1700 as Eidi, which upset Noreen. This led to arguments between the couple, and Noreen had also informed her family about the dispute. Noreen’s sister, Arshi, alleged that Irshad had started harassing her just 22 days after marriage. She said he often remained drunk and used to beat Noreen over minor issues. She claimed he assaulted her badly several times, even in front of others. On Monday, Noreen’s two sisters visited her house, after which the argument escalated. According to neighbours, the couple continued arguing till around 4 am on Tuesday, after which the house fell silent. SSP Sanjay Kumar Verma said the dispute over giving ₹1700 as Eidi to the sister led to the incident. The bodies of the couple and their two children were recovered from a room in the house. Police are investigating the case.

stories.title: Air India Express flight makes emergency landing in Lucknow:Was enroute to Delhi from Bagdogra when pilot noticed smoke at 36,000 ft
stories.summary: Air India Express flight made an emergency landing in Lucknow. On Monday evening, the flight was going from Bagdogra in West Bengal to Delhi. According to sources, the flight was over UP's Ambedkar Nagar when smoke was detected in the pilot's cabin. At that time, the aircraft was at an altitude of 36,000 feet. Upon detecting smoke, the pilot made a mayday call to Lucknow Air Traffic Control. After the mayday call, oxygen masks were provided to the passengers. After getting permission for an emergency landing in Lucknow, the aircraft was safely landed at 5:17 PM. Since then, the flight has been parked at Lucknow's Terminal-3. The flight had 148 passengers and crew members on board. All are safe. Many passengers were sent to Delhi by other flights, while some were accommodated in hotels. Security and technical teams are investigating the flight. Initial investigation has not revealed any clear cause of smoke or fire. Oxygen masks deployed along with 'Mayday Call' According to sources, pilots suspected smoke coming from the cabin's avionic panels (cockpit's electrical panels). The pilot made a 'Mayday call'. Along with this, the oxygen masks in the flight automatically deployed. The cabin crew instructed passengers on how to use the masks, after which passengers put on their masks. Passengers complaining to the company Many passengers on the flight are complaining to the company on social media. A passenger named Hemron Michael wrote, “I was traveling on flight IX-1523 from Bagdogra to Delhi. Due to technical problems, the aircraft was landed in Lucknow. No revised ticket has been given for the past two and a half hours. I was supposed to reach Delhi by 6:30 AM, but now it's 7:23. Still haven't received any response.” What is a Mayday call? The word MAYDAY comes from the French word 'm'aider'. It means 'help me'. A MAYDAY call is typically sent through radio to ATC or other nearby aircraft. This signal is used to receive immediate assistance, so that emergencies can be dealt with and help can arrive on time.

stories.title: Rapist and murderer of young girl sentenced to death:Prayagraj court says crime is horrifying and warrants death sentence
stories.summary: The person who raped and murdered an 8-year-old girl in Prayagraj was sentenced to death by hanging on Monday. The court also imposed a fine of 25 thousand rupees on him. This verdict was delivered by Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Court Judge Vinod Kumar Chaurasia. The judge said- The brutality committed against the innocent is a threat to society. The case is extremely cruel, inhuman, and shakes society. The possibility of the accused's reform is zero. Therefore, the convict deserves the death penalty. The court delivered the verdict within 18 months of the incident. Five days earlier, the accused was convicted. The case belongs to the Soraon police station area. On October 3, 2024, 26-year-old accused Mukesh Patel abducted the girl who was returning after watching Durga Puja. Later, he murdered her. 12 days after the incident, the police arrested the accused in an encounter. Know the full case Public Prosecutor (Government Lawyer) Vinay Kumar Tripathi said that on October 3, 2024, the girl went to the Durga Puja pandal near Shivgarh intersection. She was returning home at 6:30 PM when she went missing. The next day, October 4, her body was found in a paddy field on the outskirts of the village. There were severe injury marks on the body. Her hands, feet, and teeth were broken. Blood and foam were coming out of her mouth, and her private parts were severely injured. On the complaint of the girl's mother, a case was registered against an unknown accused. The post-mortem confirmed murder after rape. Police investigation revealed that on the evening of the incident, the accused Mukesh was seen taking the girl on a bicycle. Shot in encounter after 12 days The public prosecutor stated that at that time, the police claimed that the accused first raped the innocent girl and then repeatedly attacked her face to hide her identity. Her teeth were broken, her face was injured, and both her hands were also broken. On October 16, police arrested the accused in an encounter. When police surrounded him in the Ganganagar area, he started firing and tried to escape. He was shot in the leg in retaliatory firing. Charge sheet filed in December 2024 The public prosecutor stated that after investigation, the police filed the charge sheet on December 10, 2024. On December 21, 2024, the court framed the charges. On March 26, 2026, the accused was convicted. This is the 10th death sentence in 49 years at the Prayagraj District and Sessions Court.

stories.title: Gang rape attempt inside Kanpur University's classroom:Professor’s daughter alleges 3 students force themselves on her in class
stories.summary: A case of attempted gangrape in the classroom has come to light involving a student of Chhatrapati Shahu Ji Maharaj University (Kanpur University) in Kanpur. The student stated that three boys forcibly molested her in the classroom. Then they attempted gangrape. The student said, 'I am in depression because of the accused's actions.' The student has complained about the matter to the Vice-Chancellor and Registrar and filed a report at the police station. Currently, the university's Internal Committee has started investigating the matter. A case has been registered against three students at the Kalyanpur police station based on the father's complaint. The incident took place on March 16. Full incident details The victim student stated, On March 16, three students called me to the classroom to eat. During this, seeing the classroom empty, the three started molesting and attempting gangrape. When I screamed, they threatened to kill me. The father said, My daughter was very disturbed after the incident. She is scared and intimidated. She told me and her mother about the incident on March 29. After this, the three students are threatening to kill my daughter and the entire family by showing them pistols and sharp weapons.The accused boys are threatening to gangrape my daughter again. It is being told that the victim's father is a professor in another university. After this incident in the university, the investigation has intensified. Regarding the matter, Pro-Vice-Chancellor Prof. Sudhir Kumar Awasthi said, The student has come and lodged a complaint. The internal committee is investigating the matter. The committee will submit its report in a week. Some students have also been questioned. The police are also talking about registering an FIR in the matter. Kalyanpur police station in-charge Santosh Kumar Singh said, On the complaint of the victim student's father, a case has been registered against three students Vaibhav Mishra, Anuj Vishwakarma, and Ritesh Nirmal. The matter is being investigated.
