stories.title: Tea for ₹10 now ₹15 in Gorakhpur:Commercial cylinder shortage forces price hike, shopkeepers say, 'No option left but to increase rates'
stories.summary: Drinking tea in Gorakhpur has now become a burden on the common man's pocket because severe shortage of commercial gas cylinders in the city, tea prices have surged. The tea that was available for ₹10 some time ago has now increased to ₹15 at most carts and shops. Tea rates have increased at various places including Golghar, Ganesh Chowk, Student Union Square, GDA Tower, Civil Lines Road across the city. At many places, shopkeepers have also put up notices regarding the increased rates. Shopkeepers running tea and snack shops say that commercial cylinders are not available in the market at all. Even if cylinders are available from private agencies, they have to pay a very high price for them. Facing difficulties due to unavailability of cylinders Ravi Gupta, who runs a snack shop near the RTO office, said that commercial cylinders are not available anywhere. Even if we get a cylinder from a private agency sometimes, it's at a very high rate. We have to pay 1000 more per cylinder compared to before. That's why we had to increase the tea rates. Gas has disrupted the budget He says that costs have increased due to rising gas cylinder prices and shortages. Milk and sugar are already expensive, and now gas has disrupted the budget. Selling tea at old rates is now proving to be a loss-making deal. He said that tea has the highest demand in the shop, so we have only increased the rate of tea. Cylinder costing 1800 now available at 2900 Meanwhile, Vishal Yadav says that he did not want to increase the tea rates, but he had to take this decision out of compulsion. When fuel itself is expensive, it is not possible to serve tea to customers at the old price. When commercial cylinder won't be available, there will be a lot of difficulty He said that the cylinder which was earlier available for 1800 is now available for 2600 to 2900, and that too with great difficulty. Therefore, for the last 15 days, we have been selling tea at increased rates. However, we are not getting much benefit from this either. Until commercial cylinders become available, we will face a lot of difficulties. When cylinders become available and within budget, then tea rates can be reduced again. Customers Troubled Meanwhile, people who drink tea daily are somewhat troubled by these suddenly increased prices, but seeing the shopkeepers' difficulties, they are ready to pay 15 rupees. They say that the LPG crisis is affecting every sector of the country. Manoj Bhatt, who came to drink tea, said that tea rates have increased. What can shopkeepers do, they are getting cylinders at higher rates so how can they serve tea at old rates. Out of compulsion, we have to pay 15 instead of 10. We have to compromise with time.

stories.summary: Meat, fish and meat shops will remain closed on Tuesday in the Varanasi Municipal Corporation area. The Municipal Corporation has issued strict instructions in this regard. This order has been issued in view of Mahavir Jayanti. The Municipal Commissioner said that if any shop is found open, strict action will be taken against it. Shops will remain closed on Mahavir Jayanti Municipal Commissioner Himanshu Nagpal informed - On Tirthankar Mahavir Birth Kalyanak (Mahavir Jayanti), the government has banned animal slaughter in all slaughterhouses across the state on Tuesday to respect religious sentiments and maintain peace in the city. Additionally, the sale of meat etc. has also been banned in public places. As a result, all shops in the Varanasi Municipal Corporation area will remain closed. Strict action will be taken if found open Municipal Corporation's Veterinary and Welfare Officer Dr. Santosh Pal said - On March 31, all slaughterhouses and meat-fish shops in the municipal corporation area will remain closed. An order has been issued regarding this. In such a situation, if any shop is found open today or meat-fish is seen being sold in public places, strict action will be taken

stories.title: BSP chief Mayawati holds meeting with 250 party leaders:Nephew Akash and party Gen Secy among others in attendance; to discuss upcoming polls
stories.summary: BSP supremo Mayawati is holding a meeting with 250 party leaders in Lucknow on Tuesday. It includes district presidents and divisional coordinators from all districts of UP. In this meeting being held at the BSP office, Mayawati's chair is placed in the middle, while National Coordinator Akash Anand, General Secretary Satish Chandra Mishra, and State President Vishwanath Pal are sitting on the side. At 11 AM, Mayawati reached the party office with her nephew Akash Anand. It is being reported that this meeting has been called regarding the birth anniversary of Dr. Bhimrao Ambedkar and preparations for the upcoming assembly elections. According to sources, the party plans to celebrate Baba Saheb's birth anniversary on April 14 together in Lucknow this time. Therefore, instead of small and large events, a big event has been organized, in which workers from across the state will be called. In addition, Mayawati will also give guidelines to the workers regarding the UP assembly elections. The expert says that Mayawati had demonstrated her strength in Lucknow on Kanshiram Jayanti on October 9. She wants to do a similar show of strength again on Baba Saheb's birth anniversary. Mayawati held 10 meetings after October 9 After being reduced to one seat in the 2022 UP Assembly elections, BSP is working on an aggressive strategy for 2027. A senior party leader says - Since October 9, 2025, Mayawati has held 10 meetings with party leaders. Her emphasis is on ensuring that BSP's core vote bank does not drift away from the party. There are 3 reasons for this - 1- In UP, Congress's focus has once again shifted towards the Dalit vote bank. Just two days before Kanshiram Jayanti on March 13, Rahul Gandhi held a meeting with Dalit leaders in Lucknow. In this, he demanded that Kanshiram be awarded the Bharat Ratna. 2- Western UP has traditionally been considered a stronghold of BSP. Chandrashekhar, chief of Azad Samaj Party and MP from Nagina, is continuously trying to win over the Dalit vote bank. He is holding continuous rallies there. 3- SP also organized programs at various places across the state on Kanshiram Jayanti. Akhilesh is also continuously focusing on PDA, i.e., Pichda (Backward), Dalit, and Alpasankhyak (Minority) vote bank. BSP shrunk from 206 to 1 assembly seat BSP, which won 206 assembly seats in 2007, is now in a state where it has only one MLA in the assembly. In the 2022 assembly elections, BSP received 12.9 percent of the votes out of 15.2 crore voters in the state. It received a total of 11,873,137 votes. BSP's situation did not improve in the 2024 Lok Sabha elections either. BSP, which won 10 seats in the 2019 Lok Sabha, could not even open its account this time. Its vote percentage fell from 19.43% in 2019 to 9.35%. This was also about 3 percent less than the assembly elections.

stories.title: Agent buys kidney for ₹6 lakh, sells for ₹80 lakh:Transplant racked busted in Kanpur; 6 arrested including doctor couple
stories.summary: A major illegal kidney transplant racket has been busted in Kanpur. Police and health department teams conducted simultaneous raids at hospitals, where donors and recipients were found admitted in ICU. A deal of ₹60 lakh was struck for a kidney, but the donor was paid only ₹9.5 lakh. The racket came to light after a Police busted an illegal kidney transplant racket in Kanpur late on Monday night. A 23-year-old MBA student from Bihar was made to sell his kidney for ₹6 lakh, which was later sold to a 30-year-old female patient for around ₹80 lakh. After the donor filed a complaint, police conducted simultaneous raids at Med Life Hospital, Ahuja Hospital, and Priya Hospital on Monday night. At Med Life Hospital, the MBA student and the patient were found to be admitted. When asked for documents related to the transplant, the hospital failed to produce any valid papers. On Tuesday, police arrested Ahuja Hospital owner Dr. Preeti Ahuja, her husband Dr. Surjeet Ahuja, Dr. Rajesh Kumar, Dr. Ram Prakash, Dr. Narendra Singh, and agent Shivam Agarwal and sent them to jail. Police Commissioner Raghubir Lal said Shivam had persuaded an MBA fourth-semester student, originally from Bihar, to donate a kidney for ₹6 lakh. The kidney was later transplanted to Parul Tomar, a resident of Meerut. During the probe, police also found mule bank accounts linked to Ayush, and his involvement in cybercrime has also surfaced. The commissioner added that on March 3, a South African woman named Arabika also underwent a transplant at Ahuja Hospital. The entire racket was being run in an organised manner. How the kidney transplant racket was exposed According to police, an illegal kidney transplant racket was operating at Ahuja Hospital in Kalyanpur. During questioning, donor Ayush said he is originally from Samastipur in Bihar, currently lives in Meerut, and is an MBA fourth-semester student in Dehradun, Uttarakhand. He said the mastermind behind the racket is Shivam Agarwal, alias Shivam Kada, who trapped him through a Telegram group. Shivam called him to Kanpur, where a deal of ₹6 lakh was fixed at an apartment in Awas Vikas-3, Kalyanpur. Police said a kidney transplant of Muzaffarnagar resident Parul Tomar was carried out at Ahuja Hospital on Sunday. Her family paid ₹7 lakh to Shivam, with the remaining amount to be paid later. Shivam transferred ₹3.5 lakh to Ayush’s account, ₹2.75 lakh to Ahuja Hospital, ₹25,000 to Med Life Hospital for treatment, and kept ₹50,000 himself. When Ayush demanded the remaining ₹2.5 lakh, a dispute broke out. On Monday, Ayush informed the police over the phone. As soon as the hospital management got wind of police action, Ayush was shifted to Med Life Hospital, while Parul Tomar was admitted to Priya Hospital in Kalyanpur. However, police traced both. During this time, Ayush’s condition worsened, and he was admitted to Hallet Hospital. Mule accounts and cyber link emerge Police also found mule bank accounts linked to Ayush, which are used for fraudulent transactions. His involvement in cybercrime has also come to light. Police Commissioner Raghubir Lal said a South African woman, Arabika, also underwent a transplant at Ahuja Hospital on March 3, indicating the racket was well organised. Parul Tomar, the recipient, is currently undergoing treatment at Hallet Hospital. Agent posed as medical professional Agent Shivam Agarwal, an ambulance driver who studied up to class 8, used to wear an apron and carry a stethoscope to pose as a medical professional and trap victims. He was in contact with Dr Rohit alias Rahul, Dr Preeti Ahuja and Dr Surjeet Ahuja. Police said Parul, 30, has both kidneys damaged and has been on dialysis for about eight years. She was referred for transplant by the absconding doctor Afzal, after which Shivam arranged the donor. Doctor Rohit alias Rahul, who carried out transplants with his team, is absconding. No proper documentation was prepared during the procedures. The accused have been booked under the Transplantation of Human Organs Act, 1994, and relevant sections of the BNS. Network of accused revealed Dr Preeti Ahuja (MD Medicine) and her husband, Dr. Surjeet Ahuja (MD Pathology), run Ahuja Hospital in Kalyanpur. Police said 7–8 such operations were conducted there, mostly at night, after which patients were shifted to other hospitals. Donor Ayush was admitted to Med Life Hospital, run by Dr Rajesh Kumar and Dr Ram Prakash, who had earlier operated another hospital that was shut down after complaints. Dr Narendra Singh, from Musa Nagar in Kanpur Dehat, runs Priya Hospital, where the recipient Parul was admitted. He had earlier worked as nursing staff before opening his hospital. Agent Shivam Agarwal, a resident of Kalyanpur, was responsible for finding donors. He coordinated with doctors and finalised deals. Once confirmed, Dr Rohit would bring a team from Lucknow or Noida to perform surgeries. Hospitals under scanner, licences may be cancelled Additional Chief Medical Officer Dr Ramit Rastogi said joint teams of police, vigilance and doctors raided the hospitals after receiving inputs about illegal transplants. Notices have been issued to Med Life, Ahuja and Priya hospitals, seeking answers to 10 questions, including how transplant patients were admitted. Their licences may be cancelled after reviewing responses. Police said more than 50 illegal kidney transplants may have been carried out in Kanpur so far. Seven more hospitals, including one in Lucknow, are under scrutiny. Possible punishment Under the Transplantation of Human Organs Act, those found guilty can face up to 10 years in jail and a fine of up to ₹1 crore. What does the kidney do? The kidney is one of the body’s most vital organs. It filters waste, excess water, sugar and toxins from the blood, which are then stored in the bladder and expelled through urine. If the kidneys fail, they stop functioning properly. Millions worldwide live with kidney-related diseases, many without even knowing it, which is why it is often called a “silent killer”.

stories.title: No expiry date on eggs in UP:Officials says new rule may raise prices; 1.5 crore eggs arrive daily from other states
stories.summary: In Uttar Pradesh, writing expiry dates on eggs will not be implemented for now. The Food Safety and Drug Administration (FSDA) has stepped back from the rule. Officials say that if it is strictly enforced, there could be a shortage of eggs in the state and prices may rise sharply. At the same time, VP Singh, President of the UP Poultry Development Committee, has raised concerns. He claims the department is under pressure from big traders. This has led to fresh questions over the delay. What is stopping the government order from being implemented? Who will face losses? From which states does Uttar Pradesh get its egg supply, and what rules are followed there? Read the answers to these questions in this report First Reason - Eggs will not be able to come from other states In UP, people consume 3.35 crore eggs every day. These figures make UP the state with the highest consumption. Poultry farms in UP produce 1.80 crore eggs. The remaining eggs come from Haryana, Punjab, Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, and Tamil Nadu. Approximately 1.55 crore eggs are supplied daily to UP from these 5 states. This accounts for 46% of the total consumption. Actually, in these 5 states, eggs are stamped only if they are to be exported abroad. Eggs coming to UP are not stamped. In such a situation, as soon as the rules for writing production and expiry dates on eggs are implemented in UP, eggs from other states will not be able to be sold in the market. This makes it certain that there will be an egg shortage across UP. Second reason - Confusion regarding eggs kept in the market and cold storage It is also being said that if an egg is kept at a temperature of 5 degrees Celsius, it can be used for 35 to 45 days. If kept at a temperature of 25 to 35 degrees Celsius, the same eggs can be used for 14 days. Now, the production and expiry date will have to be written after the hen lays the egg. In such a situation, it will be difficult to determine which egg will go directly to the market? Which egg will be kept in cold storage? This is why FSDA is unable to implement the rule. Letter will be written to 5 states A senior FSDA official says- Among the 5 states from which eggs are supplied to UP, Haryana is the biggest supplier. Before the stamping rules for eggs are implemented in UP, letters will be written to the governments of Punjab, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Haryana, and Tamil Nadu. Inquiries are being made about the best practices in these states regarding egg expiry rules. These states will also be requested to formulate such rules so that there is no hindrance in the demand and supply of eggs. Allegation - Order not being implemented due to pressure from big traders VP Singh, President of the UP Poultry Development Committee, says - The department is making excuses. These people are under pressure from big traders in UP. The figures for supply and production provided by the Animal Husbandry Department are from 2012. Egg production in UP has increased significantly. VP Singh says - The central government made this rule in February 2023. If the department had the intention to implement it, it could have also told the concerned states that just as eggs being exported are stamped, similarly, eggs supplied in UP should also be stamped. As far as the identification of eggs sold in the open market and eggs in storage is concerned. It was suggested that different inks should be used for both. Eggs that are going into cold storage should be stamped with grey ink. Eggs that are going directly into the open market should be stamped with pink ink. What do big traders and NECC gain? VP Singh explains - Big traders, especially NECC (National Egg Coordination Committee), are not allowing such an order to be implemented to black market eggs. They manipulate egg prices up and down according to their will. They bring down the price of eggs, buy eggs from the market, and store them. When there is a shortage of eggs, they take out these expensive eggs from the store and sell them. In UP, the rate of Barwala (Punjab) is followed. Here, in the last one week, there has been a difference of 30 rupees per 100 eggs in the egg rate. On March 23, the egg rate was 385 rupees per 100 eggs. On March 30, this rate became 415 rupees. If this is calculated based on the daily supply, the difference would be approximately one crore rupees. NECC CEO said - Small traders are bound to face difficulties Ajit Singh, CEO of NECC, says - We have no objection to stamping. We had put this before the officials: do we have enough resources to implement it? How will eggs coming from outside UP be stamped? Stamping will be in a limited area and trade will be at the national level, so there will be no uniformity. Just as fruits and vegetables cannot be stamped, eggs cannot be either. As for checking the egg, the easiest method that women still use to test it is to put the egg in water and observe. If the egg sinks in water, it's good, and if it floats to the surface, it's bad. Ajit says - For eggs kept in cold storage, a complete chain is necessary to deliver them to the retailer. For instance, the egg should reach the retailer from the cold storage in a refrigerated van. Here too, it should be kept in a refrigerator. After being taken out of the refrigerator, it should be used within a maximum of 48 hours. Additionally, for small traders, the cost will increase due to stamping. This will also increase the price of the egg. Commissioner said - this is not an easy matter FSDA Commissioner Roshan Jacob says - This is not an easy matter. We have several points. The gap between demand and supply, the interests of local small-scale egg producers, and how will it be implemented? Any order should be issued keeping all these aspects in mind. For stamping on eggs, I will issue an order only after talking to the Agriculture Production Commissioner and officials of the Animal Husbandry Department.

stories.title: Big policy shift in UP from midnight:8 rules change together, Ola and Uber face registration rule; additional ₹160 per quintal on wheat MSP
stories.summary: Today is March 31. After 12 midnight, several rules will change in Uttar Pradesh. These changes will affect areas like property registry, tax, and banking. People may see a direct impact on their daily lives. Here are 8 important rules you should know. 1. You will have to pay more toll tax on highways Toll rates on all National Highways passing through UP have been increased by 5 to 45 rupees. Additionally, NHAI has increased the annual FASTag pass fee from 3000 to 3075 rupees. Also, cash payments at National Highway toll plazas will be completely stopped. Payments will only be accepted via FASTag or UPI. 2. 2% extra development fee on the property registry Several rules have been changed in UP to prevent property fraud. Now, the identity of the property seller will be cross-checked with the Khatauni (land record). The Stamp and Registration Department will thoroughly investigate the 'ownership rights' of the property. Stamp duty will be charged based on the circle rate. An additional 2% development charge will have to be paid within the municipal corporation limits. Now, registration will have to be done within the allotted one-hour time. If missed, a new slot will have to be booked. Until now, a full day's slot was available. 3. UPI will also be included in ATM withdrawals HDFC Bank will now also count UPI withdrawals in free ATM withdrawals. This means that customers who withdraw via UPI at an ATM will also be considered an ATM withdrawal. Currently, the bank offers 5 free ATM withdrawals per month. After this, ?23 will have to be paid for every extra withdrawal. Punjab National Bank has changed the daily transaction limits for some of its debit cards. Based on the card category, customers will now be able to withdraw up to ?50,000 to ?75,000 daily. Bandhan Bank ATM users will get 3 free transactions per month, while this limit will be 5 transactions at other bank ATMs. After crossing the limit, a charge of ?23 will be applied. Additionally, if a transaction fails due to insufficient funds in the account, a penalty of ?25 will be charged. 1. Wheat MSP will increase by 160 rupees The UP government has increased the Minimum Support Price (MSP) for wheat procurement in 2026-27 to 2585 rupees/quintal. This is 160 rupees more than last year. Additionally, farmers will receive an extra 20 rupees/quintal for unloading, sieving, and cleaning the wheat. This means a total of 2605 rupees will be paid to the farmer for one quintal of wheat. 2. Ola-Uber will not operate without registration After amendments to the Motor Vehicle Act, companies like Ola-Uber will now be required to register in UP. The registration will need to be renewed after 5 years. Now, if both the cab driver and passenger cancel a booking, a 10% penalty of the fare will be imposed. Police verification, medical test, and fitness test for drivers have also been made mandatory. 3. Aadhaar Card Not Valid as Age Proof for PAN Card If your name is written differently on your PAN card and Aadhaar card, your PAN card will be deactivated. In such a case, you might face difficulty claiming a refund. Additionally, Aadhaar card will not be valid as age proof for getting a new PAN card. To prove your age, you will have to provide a birth certificate or a high school marksheet/certificate. 4. Landlord's PAN Required for HRA Exemption The Income Tax Act-2025 will come into force. It will replace the nearly 60-year-old Income Tax Act of 1961. Now, if you pay more than ?1 lakh in rent annually, you will have to provide your landlord's PAN card. This essential information will need to be provided in the new Form-124. The aim is to curb fraudulent House Rent Allowance (HRA) claims. Additionally, in Income Tax, there will now be only one 'Tax Year' instead of 'Financial Year' and 'Assessment Year'. 5. Charges will be deducted for cancelling railway tickets New rules regarding train ticket cancellation will come into effect. Now, if you cancel a ticket 72 hours before the train's departure, only a flat charge will be deducted. In this case, you will receive the maximum refund. If you cancel a ticket between 72 hours and 24 hours before the train's departure, 25% of the fare will be deducted, and if cancelled between 24 hours and 8 hours, 50% of the fare will be deducted for the refund. However, no refund will be given if cancelled less than 8 hours before departure.

stories.title: Mathura sees hail, Ghaziabad plunged into darkness:Rain, strong winds warning in 40 districts; weather to stay adverse tomorrow
stories.summary: The spell of unseasonal rain continues in Uttar Pradesh. It rained in Lalitpur at 4 AM on Tuesday. Clouds are overcast in 10 districts including Varanasi-Meerut. The Meteorological Department has issued a rain alert for 40 districts today. During this period, strong winds are likely to blow at a speed of 30 to 40 kilometers per hour. According to the Meteorological Department, a new western disturbance has become active. Due to this, there has been a change in the weather. Talking about the last 24 hours, Banda remained the hottest. The maximum temperature recorded here was 41.2 degrees. Light rain occurred in seven districts of Western UP, including Bulandshahr. The spell of rain has been continuing for the last 10 days since March 21. Due to this, crops have been damaged. According to the UP government, crops of 15 thousand farmers spread over 4300 hectares have been damaged in the last 15 days. Out of these, 244.23 hectares of crops were damaged due to hailstones and 4053.11 hectares due to heavy rain. So far, 10,278 farmers have received compensation. The rest are being given. CM Yogi has instructed officials to go to the field and assess the damage. See weather photos- Light sunshine is out in Meerut on Tuesday morning. But there is a chill in the weather. Lucknow's meteorologist Atul Singh said - The effect of the Western Disturbance has started to show in the state. Today and tomorrow, there will be rain across the entire state. The weather will be clear on April 2. After this, there will be rain in Western UP on April 3 and 4. There is also a possibility of hail and storms. The temperature will drop by 3-5C. Know the status of cities What will the weather be like for 4 days? Farmers affected by rain received compensation of ₹4.5 crore According to the UP government, a relief amount of ₹13.34 lakh has been given to 286 farmers affected by hailstones so far. At the same time, compensation of ₹4.47 crore has been given to 9,992 farmers affected by heavy rains. The damage to the remaining affected people is being assessed. They will be provided relief soon.

Israel claims the killing of Iran's navy commander Israel has claimed that it has killed Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) Navy Commander Alireza Tangsiri in attacks on Iran's Bandar Abbas city. 2. ‘Monalisa trapped in jihadis’ net’: Director Sanoj Mishra rubbishes allegations of inappropriate touching of Mahakumbh girl Film director Sanoj Mishra spoke publicly for the first time after Monalisa Bhonsle made allegations against him. 3. Row erupts over BJP’s new district executive appointments: Attempt-to-murder accused gets general secretary post The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) in Uttar Pradesh has come under scrutiny after announcing its district executive committees, which were finalised after significant delays and internal deliberations. 4. stories.title: Digvijaya Singh visits Ram Temple in Ayodhya for first time:Congress leader says, 'Faith must not be used for politics'
stories.summary: Former MP CM and Congress Rajya Sabha MP Digvijaya Singh visited Ayodhya for the first time today, Thursday, to have darshan of Ram Lalla. Congress workers welcomed him at Ayodhya's International Airport. After that, he went to meet former Uttar Pradesh Congress President Nirmal Khatri at his residence. This is the first time Digvijaya Singh has visited Ayodhya and had darshan of Ram Lalla after the construction of the Ram Temple and the Pran Pratishtha ceremony. We do not use religion for business politics: Digvijaya Singh After having darshan of Ram Lalla in Ayodhya, Digvijaya Singh said, “In Congress, every person follows religion according to their faith. We do not misuse religion for business nor for politics.” "No matter what religion a person belongs to, be it Hindu, Muslim, Sikh, Parsi, or Christian, every person practices their religion according to their faith. But it should not be politically misused. Religion should not be misused for business as well," he added. Regarding the Iran-Israel war, Digvijaya Singh said, “Everyone is seeing the crowds at cooking gas stations and petrol pumps. When the Lord calls, every person comes. Also, it is not possible that you come to Lord Ram's abode and do not visit Hanuman Ji.” Digvijaya went to ask for a Rajya Sabha seat: BJP On Digvijaya Singh's visit to Ayodhya to see Ramlala, BJP's state media in-charge Ashish Agrawal said, “Digvijaya Singh is making various efforts after losing his Rajya Sabha seat. I think he has either gone to ask for that same Rajya Sabha seat or to put pressure on the Gandhi family.”

stories.title: Weather to remain disturbed in UP for 5 days:Rain and hail alert, winds up to 50 kmph; know where it will rain today
stories.summary: The weather in Uttar Pradesh is likely to stay unsettled for the next five days, with rain and strong winds expected in many areas. The Meteorological Department has issued a rain alert for the western parts of the state today. Cloud movement will continue on Thursday in districts such as Bareilly, Agra and Mathura. Some places may see light drizzle during the day, while winds could reach speeds of up to 50 kmph. According to the Meteorological Department, the change in weather is due to the impact of a Western Disturbance. The spell of storms and rain that began last week is expected to continue till the end of March, with chances of thunder, lightning and even hailstorms in some areas. However, no rainfall was recorded anywhere in the state in the last 24 hours. As a result, temperatures rose by up to 5°C. Prayagraj was the hottest place with a maximum temperature of 35.6°C, while the lowest temperature was recorded in Bijnor at 14.5°C. Lucknow's meteorologist, Atul Kumar Singh, said- Two western disturbances are becoming active in the state. Light rain will begin in Western UP from today. Gradually, its effect will reach Eastern UP. The second disturbance will become active on March 29. This will bring good rain across the entire state. Wind will blow at a speed of 40-50 (kmph). There will be a drop of 4C to 5C in temperature. A feeling of cold will be experienced. See 3 pictures of the weather Weather conditions in Western UP Why the fluctuations in the weather? The Meteorological Department says that the weather in the mountains of Uttarakhand is constantly changing. A rain and snowfall alert has been issued for the next 2 to 3 days. Its direct effect will be seen in UP. Cold winds coming from the mountains will make one feel cold. Damage to wheat and pigeon pea crops due to the storm, and how to protect them Agricultural experts say that rain and strong winds will affect Rabi, Zaid, and horticultural crops. At this time, pods are forming in pigeon pea, mustard, gram, peas, moong, and groundnut. Grains are filling. Strong winds can cause pods to burst and grains to fall off. Wheat crops can also fall due to strong winds, which poses a risk of reduced yield. In vegetables, flowers, and small fruits of okra, tomato, bottle gourd, cucumber, watermelon, muskmelon, brinjal, and chilli can fall off. Farmers have been advised to immediately harvest the ripened crop and store it in a safe place. Do not allow water to accumulate in the fields; arrange for proper drainage for this. The government said - If crops fall, farmers can claim insurance Amidst the recent rain and hailstorms and the upcoming alert, there is good news for farmers whose crops have been damaged. According to the government, if crops are damaged within 14 days of harvesting, farmers can claim insurance under the Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana. The district administration will survey crop damage due to natural calamities and submit a report, based on which the UP government may decide to provide compensation.

stories.title: Congress Rajya Sabha MP Digvijaya Singh visits Ram Lalla:Offers prayers at Hanumangarhi, says he came after receiving divine call
stories.summary: Congress Rajya Sabha MP and former Chief Minister of Madhya Pradesh, Digvijaya Singh, arrived in Ayodhya on Thursday morning. First, he offered prayers at the Hanumangarhi temple. After that, he visited Ram Lalla and then went to Kanak Bhawan to seek blessings. During this, Congress leaders and workers were also present. Speaking to the media, Digvijaya Singh said - When the Lord calls, everyone comes. So when I received the call, I came. It felt good to have darshan of the Lord. I also contributed to becoming Ram Kanak Bhawan belongs to the Maharaja of Tikamgarh, Madhya Pradesh, and I also went there to seek blessings. He had a long-standing wish to have a darshan of Ramlala. I also made a small contribution to the construction of the Ram Temple. The Lord called, and we came. In Congress, every person practices religion according to their faith. We do not misuse religion for business or for politics. When asked about the development of Ayodhya, he said - A one or two-hour journey doesn't reveal much; the people of Ayodhya know what the impact will be. Meanwhile, on the fuel and gas shortage in the country, Digvijaya Singh said - under BJP rule, not only are there queues. People are becoming poorer and poorer. Some people are becoming richer and richer. Congress workers welcomed him at the airport This was Digvijaya Singh's first visit to Ayodhya after the construction of the Ram Temple and the consecration ceremony. He arrived at Maharishi Valmiki International Airport around 9 AM, where Congress workers gave him a grand welcome. After this, he visited the residence of former UP Congress state president Nirmal Khatri to inquire about his well-being. After this, Digvijaya Singh left to visit and offer prayers at Hanumangarhi, Ramlala, and Kanak Bhawan. After completing the darshan and prayers, he departed for Lucknow. Digvijaya Singh said - I have not come to do politics On the opposition to the Ram Janmabhoomi temple, Digvijaya Singh said - I have never opposed the construction of the Ram temple. May Lord Shri Ram's blessings be upon everyone. Meanwhile, a press release issued by Digvijaya Singh's office stated that he is a descendant of Saint Pipaji Maharaj of the Ramanandi sect. In his ancestral home, Raghogarh, ancient temples of Raghuji Maharaj (Lord Ram) and Hanumanji are also located. On January 18, 2021, he donated Rs 1,11,111 to the Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Teerth Kshetra Trust for the construction of the Ram Temple. It also mentioned his 3,300-kilometre-long Narmada Parikrama, which he completed on foot, describing him as connected to the Sanatan tradition.

stories.title: Noida International Airport to become NCR’s new global gateway:Built at cost of ₹11,200 crore, PM Modi to inaugurate on March 28
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi will inaugurate the Noida International Airport in Jewar, Gautam Buddh Nagar, on March 28. He will visit the terminal at around 11:30 am and formally open Phase-1 of the airport at 12 pm. He will also address a public gathering during the event. The Noida International Airport, also known as Jewar Airport, is one of the largest new airports being built in India. It has been developed under a public-private partnership model with an investment of about ₹11,200 crore. This will be the second major international airport serving the Delhi-NCR region, alongside the Indira Gandhi International Airport. The new airport is expected to boost connectivity and help turn NCR into a major global aviation hub. Key Features of the Airport Designed as a Multi-Modal Transport Hub The airport has been designed as a multi-modal transport hub, ensuring easy integration of road, rail, metro, and regional transit systems. Located along the Yamuna Expressway, this airport will ensure excellent connectivity for both passengers and cargo. Direct and Fast Connectivity from Delhi-NCR To give new momentum to traffic in Noida, a 1.8 km-long elevated road is being built from Chilla Road to Sector-94. For this, the Noida Authority has approved a budget of 150 crore rupees. This route will provide direct access from Delhi to Noida International Airport and will provide permanent relief from heavy traffic jams in Sector-18 and Film City. The inauguration of Noida International Airport is considered a significant step that will take India's aviation infrastructure to new heights. This project will not only reduce congestion in the NCR but also boost regional and international connectivity.

stories.title: Akhilesh mocks govt over gas crisis, says he got clay-stoves:On his party leader Pooja Pal's removal, SP chief claims she was 'misled'
stories.summary: SP chief Akhilesh Yadav took a jibe at CM Yogi during a press conference at 12 noon on Thursday in Lucknow. He said - he is even more shrewd than the shrewd. They misled our MLA (Pooja Pal). Tell us, where should we file the FIR. He said - She was a woman, that's why she wasn't removed earlier. Later she had to be removed out of compulsion. These statements are being made so that she gets a ticket from somewhere. Actually, on March 24, Pooja Pal had said that CM Yogi is a shrewd chief minister. He ended mafias like Atiq and Mukhtar Ansari. Akhilesh also questioned the CM's English tweet. He said- He didn't write this tweet himself, rather it was done through AI, whose lie has been caught. Those who don't know the full form of AI, how will they understand PDA. How will they understand the pain and suffering of PDA. The SP chief also raised questions about the MOUs signed by the government. He said that the MOUs have no financial basis. All MOUs should be investigated. Regarding the gas shortage, he said - We have built two clay stoves. Read Akhilesh Yadav's key points 1- As the pain increases, the PDA will keep growing Akhilesh said - Don't fall for CM's words, he is not a Yogi. He can say anything. It's time to move on. We hear that a movie 'Ganja Ganj' is being made. As the pain increases, the PDA will keep growing. Therefore, we Samajwadi people are moving forward by uniting them to bring respect to PDA. 2- BJP government's MoUs should be investigated Akhilesh said that many MoUs signed during BJP government have no financial basis. We demand that all MoUs signed so far should be investigated. These were done to mislead the public. He said - The government is also spreading confusion in the name of AI. There's talk about a company that was formed in 2025 and its website was created in 2026. The whole matter came to light just from the 5% incentive. 3- 'Everyone in BJP is a Propaganda Minister' Attacking BJP sharply, Akhilesh said that during Hitler's time there was one propaganda minister, but in the BJP government all ministers at the center and state are propaganda ministers. Everyone thinks of themselves as the Prime Minister. He said- BJP is the first political party in the world that spends billions of rupees to tarnish others' image. He said- The sofa they are breaking in Lok Bhavan, who got it made? Who got Lok Bhavan built? 4- 'BJP only made people stand in lines' Taking a jibe at inflation and gas cylinders, Akhilesh said that a new month is coming, what did people get in BJP government except standing in lines? People make budgets planning to refill cylinders at month end. He alleged that the government reduced 14.2 kg cylinder to 10 kg. We have made two clay stoves at our home. We have arranged to cook food with wood and coal at our place. If there is difficulty for one more month, everyone will have to do the same. Small traders who used to sell chaat, samosa, momos etc. on gas are facing the most trouble. 5- Asked about dress code in Parliament - Should we wear shorts Akhilesh commented on Parliament dress code - Should we wear shorts? He himself has stopped wearing shorts and wears pants. If all BJP people come wearing shorts, we will also come wearing them. 6- Announcement of Emperor Ashoka's statue Akhilesh announced that Emperor Ashoka's statue will be installed on a golden throne at the River Front in Lucknow.

stories.title: 'Monalisa trapped in the net of jihadis':Director Sanoj Mishra rubbishes allegations of inappropriate touching of Mahakumbh girl, who married with a Muslim
stories.summary: Film director Sanoj Mishra spoke publicly for the first time after Monalisa Bhonsle made allegations against him. In a video released on Wednesday, he said his determination to make ordinary things special “burned my own hands,” but he added he does not regret trying sincerely. He claimed that Monalisa is “trapped in the net of jihadis” and is being trained to make false accusations. He said her entire family, including her mother, sister, father Jai Singh, and other Sanatani people, support him. Fight against Love-Jihad will continue- Sanoj Mishra added that his fight against what he called Love-Jihad will continue. He also said this is not the first time his character has been questioned, and every time, the truth has come out. On Tuesday, Monalisa Bhonsle accused Mishra of touching her inappropriately during the shooting of the film The Diary of Manipur. At a press conference in Kochi, Kerala, she said he touched her ten times and called him “not a good person.” She also said her family did not support her, and she questioned whether facing such harassment is expected from newcomers in the film industry. Monali had sought security from the Central, Kerala, and Madhya Pradesh governments Monali had sought help from the Central government along with the Kerala and Madhya Pradesh governments. She had said that she and her husband Farman are receiving death threats. Her posters are being burnt. The director is spreading false information about her. She does not want to work with such a person. Monalisa said - If separated from husband, both will commit suicide Monalisa said - False accusations regarding the marriage should not be made against her husband. Both got married in a temple according to Hindu rituals. The director is calling their marriage 'love jihad'. He is trying to spread tension in society. If an attempt is made to separate her from her husband, both will commit suicide. Farman said - The director is calling him a terrorist Farman also alleged that the director is calling him a terrorist. Accusations are being made against him because he was born into a Muslim family and his name is Farman Khan. He believes in Sree Narayana Guru. They got married in one of his temples. Sanoj said - Kerala's Christian missionary is conducting a joint operation with jihadists 24 hours after Monalisa's allegations, Sanoj Mishra released a video on Wednesday to clarify. He said - For the past several days, Monalisa's love jihad matter has been ongoing. After that, I started a campaign against love jihad with the victim's family. This was widely praised across the country, but now the matter is changing. Along with jihadists, Kerala's Christian missionary is also conducting a joint operation against me. That girl is being persuaded and made to say baseless things on social media. 'I will not bow my head before jihadists' He said - Today I am feeling the pain of that father, for whom Monalisa said that she fears for her life from that man. All this has been happening since the launch of my film's trailer, but I will not bow my head before jihadists. In the coming time, a major accident might happen to me or my family, which is why I have come before you through this video. 'Something untoward might happen to me' He said that he would need everyone's support. My mother is very ill. Your support will become my strength. The entire episode has been fabricated to defame Sanatan Dharma and portray Hindu-Muslim marriages as successful, but the public knows that all this is wrong. Monalisa's father said - Never complained Meanwhile, in a conversation with Dainik Bhaskar, Monalisa's father, Jaisingh Bhonsle, also called the allegations false. He said that during the shooting, he and his family were with Monalisa 24 hours a day. Sanoj Mishra considers her like his own daughter. Sanoj is helping us, which is why he is being targeted. He appealed to his daughter that she should not make false allegations under anyone's pressure.

stories.title: Body of child hidden in container, covered with flour sack:Throat slit in Agra, remains found in tenant’s room, mother faints; police hunt suspect
stories.summary: An 8-year-old girl, daughter of a shoe trader, was found murdered with her throat slit in Agra. Her body was discovered on Wednesday night around 8 PM inside a metal container kept in a tenant’s room. The container had been filled with flour on top to conceal the body. The child had gone missing on Tuesday afternoon while playing outside her home. Her body was recovered nearly 30 hours later. Upon seeing her daughter’s body, the mother fainted. The incident created tension in the area, with residents taking to the streets in protest. Tenant absconding, primary suspect Police suspect the tenant, identified as Sunil, who worked as a painter and lived in a rented room above the factory owned by the girl’s father. He has been missing since the incident and is believed to be the main accused. According to police, a case of kidnapping and murder has been registered against him, and 10 teams have been deployed to trace him. See 3 pictures related to the incident How the child went missing The victim’s father said the girl left home around 2 PM on Tuesday to play with neighborhood children. When she did not return by evening, the family initially assumed she had gone for tuition. However, when she failed to return by 4:30 PM, concern grew, and a search was launched. Police were informed, and CCTV footage from the area was examined. The girl was last seen buying chips from a nearby shop before heading back toward her home. Search operation and Rising suspicion Police formed four teams: Initially, no clue was found. The father later informed police that the tenant had been helping in the search and had even accompanied him to the police station to file a missing complaint. However, suspicion arose when the tenant suddenly disappeared after locking his room. Body recovered from tenant’s room Acting on suspicion, police broke open the tenant’s locked room on Wednesday night. Inside, they found the girl’s body stuffed inside a flour container. A sack of flour and a red quilt had been placed over it to hide the body. Public outrage and Road blockade As police attempted to take the body for postmortem, family members and locals protested, demanding the arrest of the accused first. The situation escalated into a road blockade on Fatehabad Road, with stone-pelting and attempts to vandalize vehicles. The protest continued for about 30 minutes before police officials, including DCP City Syed Ali Abbas, intervened and calmed the crowd, assuring swift action. Postmortem findings The postmortem, conducted on Thursday morning by a panel of three doctors, revealed: The body was handed over to the family and buried around 9:30 AM. Family demands strict action The victim’s aunt demanded the harshest punishment for the accused, even calling for an encounter. Police have assured that the case will be taken to a fast-track court and strict action will be ensured.

stories.title: Rush at petrol pumps in UP, Gorakhpur DM steps in:Police deployed in Gonda and Prayagraj; officials assure stock available for 22 days in state
stories.summary: Rumours about petrol and diesel shortage spread across several districts in Uttar Pradesh, leading to panic buying on Wednesday night. Large crowds gathered at petrol pumps in Gorakhpur, Gonda, Deoria and Maharajganj, with many people bringing big containers to stock fuel. Long queues were seen at several places, where people waited for hours. In Prayagraj and Gonda, police had to step in at petrol pumps to control the situation, after which fuel was supplied to people. Oil companies have a 22-day stock. So, do not pay attention to rumors. There is no need to panic and buy or hoard excessive fuel - Sanjay Bhandari, coordinator for oil companies In Gorakhpur, due to the rumors, DM Deepak Meena and SSP Dr. Kaustubh came out on the streets late at night. They visited pumps and appealed to people not to fall for rumors. People should take diesel and petrol as they do on normal days. There is no need to stand in long queues. There was a huge crowd at petrol pumps in Gonda late into the night. Farmers were seen standing in long queues to get diesel. Farmers fear that if diesel runs out, they will face difficulties in threshing wheat in the coming days. About 13,168 petrol pumps are operating in the state. Pump owners say that the crowd suddenly increased by 3 to 4 times. They didn't even understand why the crowd suddenly increased, even though there was sufficient oil. See 3 pictures

stories.title: IPS officer hits back at body shamers:Says she will deal with trolls; many who commented had no photos on profiles
stories.summary: Mirzapur SP Aparna Rajat Kaushik has come into the spotlight after facing heavy trolling on social media. A video of her press briefing received thousands of body-shaming and offensive comments, raising serious concerns. The situation became so serious that the police social media team had to disable the comment section. Speaking on the issue, IPS Aparna Kaushik said that harassment in public places has largely reduced, but such behaviour has now shifted online. She added that strict action will be taken to deal with this problem as well. Read the full interview verbatim Question: What was your reaction after reading comments on Instagram for the first time? Aparna- When the comments started coming in, I watched them for 15 to 20 minutes. The people who were commenting hadn't even put their photos on their IDs. I thought, why should I waste my energy on people who don't have confidence in themselves? I have bigger things to do. Question- What did you do after seeing the comments? Aparna- I look at everything like a police officer. When the police team analyzed the data, most of them turned out to be fake accounts. It will take some time to find out about them. As a police officer, I have to set priorities: we listen to people's problems first, then our own. Question- How do you feel as a woman after seeing vulgar comments? Aparna- It's not that this only happens to women; many men also face such behavior. Comments are made on their appearance. Often, people prefer to engage in negative things. After you've made a comment, you should think, "Did I become a good person by doing this?" Ask anyone who made a comment what they contributed? They won't be able to give any answer. Question- Has people's mindset towards women not changed yet? Aparna- You know, abuses are always female-centric. Whenever I go to schools, I tell the boys, "Who are you pointing out when you use those abuses? You also have a mother, a sister at home." This becomes a 'part of the psyche'. You start looking at females through the same lens. We will have to stop these things. We tell them that females are inferior, and they are superior. If you look today, many girls are board toppers, they top exams. Question- Is there a need for big action on social media comments? Aparna- Look, earlier eve-teasing or harassment used to happen in physical spaces. Gradually, this has shifted to online spaces. As society is evolving, the pattern of crime has also changed. We are training our team to deal with this. There's another thing, there are also people among them who only have 2 followers. We should not spend our energy on such people. Question- Some IDs are no longer visible after commenting on your post? Aparna- You are right. I myself saw that as quickly as they commented, they also ran away with their tails between their legs. If you do something wrong, it's obvious that you will have fear. Whatever wrong you do, whether in physical space or social space, action will be taken. Question- Will an attempt be made to set a precedent by taking action? Aparna- Look, you cannot erase activity on social media. Its digital footprint always remains. Therefore, it is important to teach such people a lesson. If you upload reels of traffic violations, or reels doing something wrong, and it comes to our attention, action will definitely be taken. Question - Do you consider joining the civil service a success? Aparna - I am not naming that district, just telling the case. There was a widow woman between 55-60 years old. Her neighbor tried to grab her when he found her alone. Now think, she lives alone, she is a widow, what must she have felt? As soon as we received the complaint, the investigation officer worked very intelligently. We filed the charge sheet within 3 days. We strongly put the case on trial. We expedited its trial. When the verdict came in the case, the accused was punished. After this, the woman came to my office with a box of sweets to meet me. Seeing that, I became very emotional. She also became emotional. There are many cases, but sometimes when you bring full justice to its conclusion, it's a very sweet victory. In many cases, the case proceeds after the accused is caught. Sometimes we get transferred, and we don't get to see the victim receive justice. But, that time I was lucky. It is necessary that you don't stay silent, call out boldly.

stories.summary: The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) in Uttar Pradesh has come under scrutiny after announcing its district executive committees, which were finalized after significant delays and internal deliberations. Initially scheduled to be completed by March 2, the process took an additional 19 days, with committees being announced on March 21. Despite the delay, district units in Gorakhpur region—considered the stronghold of Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath—are yet to be formed. Despite extensive deliberations, the newly announced executive has quickly become mired in controversy. A shocking case has emerged from Ayodhya, where an accused in an attempt-to-murder case has been appointed as General Secretary—he is reportedly among the district’s top-10 criminals. In Lucknow, a government school teacher has been made the BJP’s media in-charge, a move that appears to violate the service rules of the education department. In Uttar Pradesh, the BJP has reorganised its structure into 98 districts, with district executives formed in each. However, the mandated inclusion of at least seven women in every executive has largely been ignored. Lalitpur remains the only district where this requirement has been fulfilled. Read this special report… Attempt-to-murder accused appointed in Ayodhya A major controversy has emerged from Ayodhya, where Shivendra Singh has been appointed as district general secretary. According to police records, Singh faces multiple cases, including attempted murder and assault. He is also listed among the top 10 criminals in the erstwhile Faizabad district. Sources claim Singh is a close associate of rebel Samajwadi Party MLA Abhay Singh. Party insiders say objections were raised by senior leaders from district to national levels, but he was appointed under pressure from a senior state-level functionary. Ayodhya city president Kamlesh Srivastava defended the decision, stating that “registration of a case does not make someone a criminal” and that investigations are ongoing. Government teacher appointed media in-charge in Lucknow In Lucknow, the party appointed Chintamani Pandey as district media in-charge, sparking another controversy. Pandey is currently serving as an assistant teacher at a primary school in Haidergarh, Barabanki. As per education department service rules, government employees are prohibited from holding positions in political parties. Pandey had previously been suspended during the 2022 Assembly elections for allegedly campaigning for BJP candidate Shalabh Mani Tripathi. Responding to the controversy, Pandey argued that council teachers are neither central nor state government employees and cited a Supreme Court observation describing teachers as “gurus.” However, Basic Education Officer Naveen Kumar Pathak clarified that such an appointment violates service rules and is not permissible. Women’s representation norms ignored The BJP has divided Uttar Pradesh into 98 organizational districts, each with a district executive committee. As per party guidelines, each committee must include at least seven women. However, except for Lalitpur, no district has fulfilled this requirement. Similarly, the rule mandating 30 women members in district executive bodies has largely been ignored. Irregularities in social representation The party had also mandated representation for Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, and Other Backward Classes based on local demographics. Sources allege that in some districts, surnames of office bearers were deliberately omitted to project them as belonging to OBC or Dalit communities. Age criteria overlooked State BJP president Pankaj Chaudhary had directed that office bearers should be between 30 and 50 years of age, with relaxations for women and SC/ST candidates. Despite this, several districts have appointed individuals aged between 60 and 65, violating the prescribed norms. Leaders from other parties dominate According to party sources, recommendations from MLAs were given significant weight in forming district committees, leading to alleged sidelining of grassroots workers. More than 30% of BJP MLAs in the state are said to have joined from other parties. Their influence has reportedly resulted in their loyalists being appointed to key district positions, leaving long-time cadre members dissatisfied. In Sarojini Nagar, supporters of MLA Rajeshwar Singh are reportedly unhappy after names recommended by him were excluded, while his opponents were accommodated. Formation timeline and Current status As per the guidelines issued by state president Pankaj Chaudhary, district committees were to be finalized by March 2. However, due to delays, announcements were made between March 20 and 21. So far, committees in over 65 districts across regions like Kashi, Braj, West, Awadh, and Kanpur have been declared, while the Gorakhpur region remains pending.

stories.title: Electricity workers to hold protest on April 11 in Lucknow:State office-bearers hold online meeting; allege harassment
stories.summary: The Electricity Employees Joint Struggle Committee, Uttar Pradesh, has accused the Power Corporation management of harassment. The organization says that strict action will now be taken against this. An online meeting of the committee's state-level officials was held on Sunday. It was decided that if the management does not stop suspension or punitive action against employees and engineers, a meeting of the Provincial Executive will be called in Lucknow on April 11, 2026. In this meeting itself, a statewide movement will be announced. Warning of Mass Satyagraha The Struggle Committee has clearly warned that if any employee, contract worker, junior engineer, or engineer is acted against with the intention of harassment, mass satyagraha will be immediately started across the state. The committee alleges that management is deliberately trying to disrupt the electricity system during the summer season so that the path for privatization of the electricity department can be cleared. Electricity workers will not let this succeed under any circumstances. Meetings will be held across the state before the main meeting Before the April 11 meeting, all affiliated labor organizations will organize meetings across the state to unite employees. Central office bearers of all organizations in the state and hundreds of active members will participate in this meeting. The committee said that the power corporation management will be responsible for all harassment. The meeting was mainly attended by several officials, including Sanjay Singh Chauhan, Jitendra Singh Gurjar, Mahendra Rai, Ankur Pandey, Mohammad Wasim, Sohel Abid, and Maya Shankar Tiwari.

stories.title: Yogi questions, 'If your vehicle has petrol, why queue up?':Warns people against spreading rumours of lockdowns
stories.summary: 'What kind of low-level efforts are being made to stop Modi? What rumors are being spread? They are saying there will be a lockdown. It is our duty that if a cylinder lasts 25 days, why are we standing in line on the 5th day? When the car has full petrol, then why are we standing in line? We must be cautious and alert about these rumour-mongers. When the country's leadership is with you, why are you worried? The public has evicted them from the government, and now they are spreading rumours. Spreading rumours is also treason.' CM Yogi said this in Lucknow on Sunday. He distributed joining letters to selected nursing officers of Dr. Ram Manohar Lohia Institute of Medical Sciences at Lok Bhavan at 4:30 PM. A total of 665 nursing officers have been selected. This includes 345 male and 320 female candidates. CM Yogi handed over joining letters directly to 20 candidates. Online joining letters will be sent to the remaining candidates. Yogi said that the results of the transparent appointment process are in front of everyone. We gave government jobs to 9 lakh candidates. Even opponents cannot question the selection process. Due to transparent appointments, there is no court intervention in this. Now read CM Yogi's important statements Everyone knows what happens to those who create irregularities Yogi says, 'Before 2017, most recruitments were hindered. With 9 lakh manpower, UP has transformed from a sick state to the country's growth engine. The state that didn't have money even for salaries is now a revenue surplus state. Today, our per capita income has tripled. There is no interference in recruitment exams. Appointment letters are distributed every week. The recruitment commission is under the third eye of the government. No irregularities should occur. Everyone knows what happens to those who try to mess with the future of youth - they are caught before they can cause any damage'. 1 lakh jobs will be created from Jewar Airport CM says, ‘We have built the biggest airport in UP yesterday. Our state is the biggest, so we will do the biggest work too. One lakh youth will get employment. Earlier, Jewar was the biggest crime center in the state. No one used to pass through there in the evening’. Today, we have made it the biggest investment center. A film city is being built there. The foundation stone of the semiconductor unit has also been laid near it. There was a time when people became helpless without oil; now they become helpless without semiconductors. Rumors of lockdown are being spread Yogi said that the world is in crisis, and there is an atmosphere of turmoil and doubt. Many countries have reduced working hours. Even in America, petrol prices are touching the sky. Our neighboring countries are also in bad condition. But, India is moving forward without stopping. Prime Minister Narendra Modi has reduced excise duty on petrol and diesel. All sections are benefiting from this. Rumors of lockdown are being spread in the country. Distribution of appointment letters every week is the result of our work CM says, ‘Zero tolerance is not only against crime and criminals. There is also zero tolerance towards corruption. The government has been working towards the goal of zero corruption since day one. As a result, every week we are involved in some appointment letter distribution program’. Akhilesh didn't visit Noida while being CM, but reached there today CM said that Akhilesh didn't visit Noida while being Chief Minister, but today reached there for divisive politics. The JPNIC building was built in the name of Jai Prakash Narayan. Its DPR was ₹200 crores, but ₹800 crores were spent on it. It's still incomplete. This is SP's development model. How dare they talk about development? They have no shame. Gomti River Front had a DPR of ₹300 crores, and ₹1400 crores were spent. Still, it remains incomplete. This is a robbery of the public's hard-earned money. As soon as jobs were announced, they would start collecting bribes. Today, even a Yadav daughter from Amethi got selected. But, she couldn't have been selected before 2017. Because her family couldn't pay money. I have already said that if any mistake is found, I will make such an example that it will become a precedent. Yogi gave joining letters to these candidates Those who received joining letters from CM Yogi include Priyanka Singh, Manish Kumar, Lakshman Ram Chaudhary, Mohammad Alam, Tanu, Sandhya Joshi, Devraj Gurjar, Devesh Kumar, Jai Prakash Singh, Dharmendra Kajla, Kumari Anamika Yadav, Deepti Devi, Pratima Kashyap, Akanksha, Rishi Raj Gautam, Aradhya Singh, Priyanka Chaudhary, Vivek Kumar Gond, Sandhya Singh and Sharima Siddiqui. According to the Health Department, these appointments will increase the nursing staff in the government hospitals of the state. This will facilitate patient treatment. The quality of services will improve. Lohia Hospital Director Dr. CM Singh said that 42,280 applications were received. Exams were conducted in 34 cities across 14 states. Out of these, 665 were selected. Minister of State for Medical Education Mayankeshwar Sharan Singh said that Lohia Institute is the largest after PGI. The more blessings you receive from patients, the more meaningful your entry into this profession will be. Deputy CM said, ‘Jewar Airport caused pain to brother’ Deputy Chief Minister Brajesh Pathak said that you all are joining a big institution. How did UP bring change? What were the conditions here before 2017? Could our daughters go out safely in the evening? Jobs were also given based on the brother-nephew's recommendations. For jobs, one had to make rounds from Etawah to Saifai for the brother-nephew's favor. Parents had to sell jewelry and land for jobs. Now, no one has asked for even 25 paise from anyone. I didn't even ask the director when the exam is happening. Which agency is it, because whoever asks will go to jail. See what the police did to the person who molested a 7-year-old daughter in Agra - this is the power of your vote. You need to tell the public that UP has the lotus, BJP, and CM Yogi. Only then is the state secure. UP is in safe hands today, in Yogi ji's hands. This white coat is a symbol of peace. The brother got hurt at the Jewar airport. They are making statements, while every person living in UP is feeling proud.

stories.title: Akhilesh says, 'Noida Airport inaugurated to be sold':SP Chief adds, 'Those who never faced oppression can’t understand our pain'
stories.summary: Akhilesh Yadav addressed the Samajwadi Samta Bhaichara Rally in Dadri, Noida, on Sunday. Taking a jibe at the inauguration of Jewar Airport, he said that 6 out of 7 airports in UP have been closed. They could have at least promised that it would not be sold after the inauguration. It seems that this inauguration was done only to sell it. He says, ‘Those who have not endured the pain of atrocities, injustice, and oppression cannot understand our pain. They can show sympathy, but they cannot feel the pain that we felt when our house was washed with Gangajal’. SP chief said; We felt this pain when temples were washed after our visit. We don't want to destroy those negative people, we just want to make them understand. Times have changed now. There is still time - stop the trickery, stop the discrimination. The future is not theirs. Otherwise, just as their flags have come down today, tomorrow they will be removed from the throne of power. Earlier, Akhilesh paid floral tributes to the statue of Emperor Mihir Bhoj of the 9th-century Gurjar-Pratihar dynasty. After that, he purified his statue with Gangajal. This rally is being considered as the beginning of SP's 2027 assembly election campaign. Actually, the Gurjar community is considered quite influential in western UP. There are about 20,000 to 70,000 Gurjar votes in about 24 seats, like Ghaziabad, Noida, Dadri, Meerut, Muzaffarnagar, Saharanpur, Bijnor, Sambhal, and Kairana. Till now, it has been supporting the BJP. Now, SP wants to make inroads into this alliance. Key points from Akhilesh’s speech: 1. Our people exposed the truth of yesterday’s rally Akhilesh said that many of their workers have exposed the reality of yesterday’s rally. “No one can escape the camera. A party that calls itself the world’s largest had to rely on government employees. Now BJP’s exit from Uttar Pradesh is certain, and after that, from Delhi as well. We have not been in power for 10 years, at least they could have accounted for their smaller ‘ATM’. This ‘ATM’ must have troubled the entire world.” 2. No one can forget the Samajwadis’ contribution to Noida’s development “We fought when others tried to take away our history and our emperors. Form the government in 2027, and we will install statues of PDA icons at the riverfront in Lucknow to honour their contributions. No one can forget the Samajwadi Party’s role in Noida’s development. This is not just a rally, but a call to bring social justice to power in the coming time.” SP leaders honoured Akhilesh on stage. 3. We must bring change, no matter how long it takes “People of PDA know and feel discrimination and disrespect. Their dignity is taken away from time to time. We must bring change, whether it takes years or even a century; we will not step back. Five per cent of people are exploiting 95 per cent and depriving them of their rights.” 4. The Constitution will remain under threat as long as BJP exists “Babasaheb gave us a document stronger than an iron sword. No matter the obstacles, we will continue to fight to end inequality. For PDA, protecting the Constitution is a matter of life and death. Those who aimed to change the Constitution by winning 400 seats went underground after losing in 2024, but the Constitution will remain in danger as long as the BJP exists.” Before his address, Akhilesh was honoured with a turban on stage. 5. Jobs have never been part of BJP’s agenda Akhilesh said jobs have never been on the BJP’s agenda. “Reservation under Babasaheb Ambedkar’s Constitution has never been part of their agenda. That is why they do not provide government jobs and instead allow exam papers to leak.” 6. Samajwadi Party secured NOC for Jewar Airport “If anyone secured the NOC for Jewar Airport, it was the Samajwadi Party. That is why the airport has been built today. In the future, we will buy farmers’ land at market rates and ensure their respect.” He added that in the coming time, they will strengthen the 1090 helpline to ensure women’s safety, restart the Samajwadi Pension scheme, and provide ₹40,000 annually to poor women to support and empower them.

stories.title: ‘Madam, my followers are in lakhs, you can’t answer’:Truck driver threatens woman ARTO in Unnao,
stories.summary: A truck driver in Unnao threatened a female ARTO officer, saying he had millions of followers on social media and she would face consequences if she could not respond. The incident took place late on Saturday night when ARTO Pratibha Gautam and her team were checking overloaded vehicles. During the checking drive in the Dahi police station area, about 10 km from the district headquarters, the team stopped five vehicles and took them to a weighbridge for inspection. However, the GPS of the truck at the front got locked, which caused other trucks standing behind to get stuck as well. This led to delays and tension at the spot. Angered by the delay, one of the truck drivers started creating a ruckus. A constable from the checking team got into an argument with him. It is alleged that during the argument, a constable from the enforcement team caught the driver by his collar and started beating him. Seeing the commotion escalate, the female ARTO got out of the vehicle. It is being said that instead of stopping the constable, she herself started pushing the driver. Accusing him of drinking alcohol, she forcibly started putting him in the vehicle. At this, the truck driver got agitated. The enforcement team took him to the Dahi police station and handed him over to the police. The enforcement team says, ‘truck driver was under the influence of alcohol and violating rules’. Meanwhile, the driver alleges that he was forcibly stopped and assaulted. See 3 pictures Now read what the ARTO said According to ARTO Enforcement Pratibha Gautam, between 9:00 and 9:30 PM on Saturday night, she was checking for overloading near a factory in the Dahi police station area with her team. She was sitting in her government vehicle. Other members of the team were stopping and checking passing vehicles. The team stopped 5 overloaded trucks. All five trucks were taken to a weighbridge for overloading inspection. During weighing at the weighbridge, one truck's GPS got locked. Because of this, it stopped there. Then the truck drivers standing behind started creating a ruckus. Some of them were intoxicated. When a constable grabbed a truck driver's collar, she went to intervene, but the truck driver started misbehaving with her too, while making a video with his mobile. He started threatening her with consequences, claiming to be a social media influencer. Therefore, he was taken into custody and handed over to the police of Dahi police station. Police Station in charge said - Action will be taken upon receiving a complaint Dahi Police Station In-charge Gyanendra Singh said; The matter reached the police station late Saturday night. But so far, we have not received any complaint. The viral video has come to our attention. Further action will be taken only after receiving a complaint.

stories.title: 30 houses being demolished in Varanasi Dalmandi:Houses razed with chisels and hammers; 150 police personnel deployed, drone surveillance
stories.summary: Around 30 houses are being demolished in Dalmandi, Varanasi, on Sunday. Workers are using chisels and hammers to bring down the structures. More than 150 police personnel have been deployed, with barricades in place and movement in the area restricted. Surveillance is being carried out using drone cameras. According to the administration, all the properties have been registered, and compensation has been transferred to the stakeholders’ accounts. The action had earlier been paused due to Eid. Before this, 22 dilapidated houses had already been demolished. Dalmandi Street is set to be developed as a model road. The Prime Minister laid the foundation stone during his 51st visit to Kashi. The state government has sanctioned ₹215.88 crore for the project, with ₹191 crore allocated as compensation to 186 property owners. PWD officials said the 650-metre stretch from New Road to Chowk police station will be widened to 60 feet, including a 30-foot road and 15-foot footpaths on both sides. Power lines, sewerage and water systems will be moved underground, clearing the existing tangle of overhead wires. Pictures of action in Dalmandi...

stories.title: Man killed in Varanasi for informing on cattle smugglers:Dragged out of home, beaten to death with kicks and punches
stories.summary: A youth was beaten to death in Varanasi after being accused of mobile theft. The attackers barged into his house at midnight, dragged Sanu Ali out of his room and took him outside the village, where they assaulted him. They kept beating him with kicks and punches until he fell unconscious. Family members chased the attackers and reached the spot. They took him in a critical condition to Heritage Hospital, where he died during treatment in the morning. The accused fled after the incident. The police were informed during the night, but Rohanian police allegedly remained negligent in taking action. Family alleges prior threats Sanu Ali’s uncle Akhtar Ali said that Sanu had informed the police about Bablu and his associates involved in cattle smuggling. The accused first threatened him and later took him from his house and killed him. Angry family members questioned the police action and demanded immediate arrests. The incident is from Rohania Panditpur village. Attack inside home, brutal beating outside The attackers created a commotion at Sanu’s home, accusing him of mobile phone theft. They then claimed they were taking him to the police station but instead took him outside the village near a petrol pump and tied him to a small bridge, where they mercilessly beat him. By the time family members reached the spot, Sanu had already died. The family alleged that the police at the scene asked the attackers to take him for medical treatment instead of taking immediate action against them.
